properties.Name: Sinnissippi Ski Touring Center
properties.Notes: Golf course skiing rolling terrain. Ideal for beginners and for lap skiing in a central city location in Rockford. Rentals available on weekends.

properties.Name: Battle Creek Regional Park East
properties.Notes: Rated easy to difficult. Parking located along Lower Afton Road east of McKnight Road.

properties.Name: Michigan Tech University Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Long downhills gathering speed and sharp turns at the bottom are distinctive of the trails you will find here. 34k of groomed trails 24k of skate trails 7k lighted trails in the evening until 9pm. Trails are groomed daily to manage the 200"+ of annual snowfall. Heated chalets at the Main Trailhead and Nara Trailhead.

properties.Name: Parc de la Yamaska
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc de la Yamaska offers about 25 km of easy ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing including an 18 km loop around the Choiniere reservoir.

properties.Name: Good Spirit Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Good Spirit Lake Provincial Park offers 19 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing along the shores of the lake.

properties.Name: Laurentian University X-C Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: In Sudbury 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Laurentian Nordic Ski Club in three linked networks: at Laurentian University Laurentian Lake Conservation Area and a golf course. The trails link to the BioSki trails to the east.

properties.Name: Michaywe' Resort
properties.Notes: 20 kilometers of cross country trails that wind around Lake Michaywe', with a lighted loop for night skiing.

properties.Name: Turville Point Conservation
properties.Notes: Woods with scenic vistas classic only trails right on shores of Lake Monana.

properties.Name: Kincaid Park
properties.Notes: Hosted Nationals and Junior Nationals in recent years.

properties.Name: Station Touristique Montagne Coupee
properties.Notes: Trails: At the Station Touristique Montagne Coupee 40 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing almost all of which have a skating lane. Two trails are rated Easy eight are Intermediate and one is Very Difficult. The centre has heavy-duty snowcat groomers that can granulate crusty snow conditions to make them more skiable.

properties.Name: Snowflake Nordic Ski Center
properties.Notes: Trails open: M-F 9 am to 8 pm; Sat/Sun 9am - 5pm. 5K lighted trails for night skiing. Trails groomed daily as necessary. Classic and skating Lessons available for individuals and groups. Warm chalet with showers sauna changing rooms lounge area snacks.

properties.Name: Sutton en Haut
properties.Notes: Trails: Sutton en Haut offers about 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only) and 6 km of backcountry trails.

properties.Name: Al Quaal Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Granite cliffs Deer Lake and Teal Lake overlooks. Lots of hills. 4K of the Teal trail is lighted.

properties.Name: Wawa Cross-Country Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Wawa has 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Graystone Trails
properties.Notes: About 17km total of trail loops near the St. Cloud penitentiary. Some scenic woods and great hills. Just a mile from the Mississippi trails run on land that was formerly a farm and takes skiers through pastures forests and apple orchards. Trails are mostly easy to intermediate with a few challenging hills.

properties.Name: Vasaloppet Nordic Center Trails
properties.Notes: This trail system starts and ends at the Vasaloppet Nordic Ski Center located on the north edge of town. The Nordic Center offers a waxing room showers and a sauna and is open throughout the season. 5K of lighted trail. Snowmaking operations.

properties.Name: Maplelag Resort
properties.Notes: Great trails expertly groomed at Maplelag. Mainly classical but some skating loops too.

properties.Name: Inuvik Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 8 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: River Road Unit Trails
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate. Part of the Golden Anniversary State Forest.

properties.Name: Spooner City Trails
properties.Notes: Located on the north side of town on College Street. Multiple loops for different skill levels.

properties.Name: Mountainview Ski Hills
properties.Notes: Trails: Mountainview Ski Hills offers 20 km of trails groomed for skating and classic.

properties.Name: Piedmont Trail
properties.Notes: The Piedmont trail has 5k of trail for beginning and intermediate skiers. This double-tracked trail leads you through both aspen birch and hardwood forest. Handmade signs made by a skier in the Piedmont neighborhood and a beautiful overlook of the St. Louis River Valley are the unique features of this trail.

properties.Name: Timberland Hills
properties.Notes: A great trail system! Nice wide trails and many challenging sections.

properties.Name: Wolverine Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Trails consist of 5 separate loops groomed by volunteers from the Wolverine Nordic Ski Club. An interesting mix for all ability levels. Heavily wooded terrain and great snow make for a wonderful ski experience.New warming shelter.

properties.Name: Fern Lake
properties.Notes: Skate and classic trail through state land and a red pine plantation. Long and mostly gradual climbs one technical downhill corner. Beautiful views along the ridgeline.

properties.Name: Parc du Domaine Vert
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc du Domaine Vert offers 25 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 5 km for skating technique.

properties.Name: Odana Hills Golf Course
properties.Notes: Mainly flat course with fairly wide trails.

properties.Name: Crimson Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Crimson Lake Provincial Park has 10 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are also 10 km of backcountry trails.

properties.Name: Pembina Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Near Drayton Valley 20 km of trails along the North Saskatchewan River are groomed for cross-country skiing (both skate and classic) by the Pembina Nordic Ski Club. Another 10 km of trails in the town of Drayton Valley are also groomed.

properties.Name: Blue Hills Trail
properties.Notes: A 32K network of well-signed trails coursing through heavily wooded hills and valleys. Timely grooming for both skating and striding. Heated log warming house toilets and ample parking.

properties.Name: Chez Ti-Jean ski de fond
properties.Notes: Trails: At Chez Ti-Jean ski de fond there are 30 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 6 km for skating. Seven trails are rated Intermediate and three Expert.

properties.Name: UW-Parkside Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Groomed by University of Wisconsin usually skating and classic. Fairly flat. Located right across the road from Petrifying Springs County Park and uses same parking lot.

properties.Name: Elver Park
properties.Notes: Two main loops: East and West trails. East trails are more hilly West trails are lighted (5K). Limited snowmaking added in 2016.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Labelle
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Club de ski de fond Labelle. Five trails are rated Easy nine Intermediate and five Difficult.

properties.Name: George Washington Pines
properties.Notes: A great beginner trail with two easy downhills. Known for its solitude and beauty. Large pines line the trail.

properties.Name: Blue Mound State Park
properties.Notes: This park is situated at the highest point in Southern WI. Tne trails wind through hardwoods and rolling hills with some fields. There are also a number of panoramic overlooks.

properties.Name: Mille Lacs Kathio State Park
properties.Notes: Ski trails available for beginners to expert skiers. The park has 10.9 K of easy trail 12.4 K of moderate trails and 8.7 K of difficult trails. All trails go through wooded terrain. Ski rental is available in the park.

properties.Name: Airport Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Airport Nordic Ski Club grooms 17 km of trails for cross-country skiing (both classic and skating). Some of the trails are rated as difficult and some as intermediate. Four km of trail are lighted for night skiing on certain evenings.

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond Charlesbourg
properties.Notes: Trails: At Centre de ski de fond Charlesbourg about 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. (The centre advertises more than 100 km of trail but that is calculated by counting overlapping sections of trails more than once.)

properties.Name: Edgewood Golf Course Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Classical trails wind through this golf course situated on the floodplain of the Red River of the North. Also 5K of skating trails.

properties.Name: Bowring & Rotary Parks
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 3 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing at Pippy Park campground. There may also be some trails at Bowring Park.

properties.Name: Owen Conservation
properties.Notes: Classic only trails flow around and through the prairie.

properties.Name: Les Aventuriers
properties.Notes: Trails: Les Aventuriers ski club grooms 33 km of trails for cross-country skiing. One 5 km trail is lighted for night skiing. The centre is the host of the annual 30 km Vasaloppet in early March.

properties.Name: Staring Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located across from Flying Cloud airport. Fairly wooded.

properties.Name: Pine Point Park
properties.Notes: Small park near the end of the Gateway Trail. There is beautiful scenery with trails winding through pine forest and near small lakes and picturesque farms. The course is quiet sheltered and has a lot of fun roling hills. Most of the terrain is intermediate in difficulty.

properties.Name: Mirror Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Features sandstone bluffs surrounding half the lake.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond La Balade
properties.Notes: Trails: The Club de ski de fond La Balade grooms 23 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 9 km for skating technique.

properties.Name: Strathcona Wilderness
properties.Notes: Trails: Strathcona Wilderness is an outdoor adventure centre with 12 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing of which 7 km are groomed for skating technique. It serves as the base for the Strathcona Nordic Ski Club. For more information see the Edmonton Nordic Ski Guide.

properties.Name: Erkki Harju Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Mostly intermediate level trails but also some beginner and expert sections. Trail runs through scenic forest of paper birch aspen spruce fir and cedar. 3K of the trail is lighted. Formerly known as Two Harbors ski trail.

properties.Name: Garland
properties.Notes: 40k groomed skating & classic. Michigan Cup race site.

properties.Name: Strathcona Science Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Strathcona Science Provincial Park has 5 km of ungroomed trails that are available for cross-country skiing. Edmonton Nordic Ski Club operates a biathlon range in the park.

properties.Name: Centre Touristique de la Petite-Rouge
properties.Notes: Trails: The Centre Touristique de la Petite Rouge offers 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 15 km for skating. Four trails are rated Easy four are Difficult and one is Very Difficult.

properties.Name: Gordon Bubolz Nature Preserve
properties.Notes: Groomed classic five trails are available. There are also trails for snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Theodore Wirth South
properties.Notes: South Wirth Park includes 10 kilometers of groomed trail with a mix of beginner intermediate and advanced trails. Trails include JD Rivers Loop Wirth Lake Loop Eloise Butler Trail Quaking Bog/Norm Oakvik Trail and Bridge Trail.

properties.Name: Hyland Lake Park Reserve
properties.Notes: A couple of good loops although it seems to get more wind-blown than other metro trails. New in 2013 5K snowmaking loop.

properties.Name: Mt Washington Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Mount Washington Resort has 55 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skating). The trails are at the 900 metre elevation so receive about 30 feet of snow annually. A few of the trails can be accessed by chairlift.A few of the resort's trails are lighted for skiing on Thursday to Saturday evenings. Backcountry skiing in Strathcona Provincial Park is possible but check avalanche conditions before heading out.Mount Washington Resort is the site of the Vancouver Island Loppet in March.

properties.Name: Bagley Nature Area
properties.Notes: Bagley Nature Area is 55 acres of forest pond and open area at the northwest part of the UMD campus. Trails also referred to as Rock Pond trails by some skiers.

properties.Name: Murphy's Point Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Murphy's Point Provincial Park 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Tay Valley Cross Country Ski Club including 4 km of skating trails. There are also 10 km of ungroomed trails.

properties.Name: Northland Arboretum
properties.Notes: Nice winding trails the Arboretum trails are rated beginner to moderate and are located right in Brainerd. Nearly 5K of the trails are lighted.

properties.Name: Government Peak
properties.Notes: Well maintained ski trails at the base of Government Peak. Home to the MatSu Ski Club.

properties.Name: Saux Head Trail
properties.Notes: Trail Difficulty: Moderate hilly. Gorgeous vistas of Saux Head Lake and Lake Superior.

properties.Name: Minnesota Landscape Arboretum
properties.Notes: Classic only cross-country trails that wind through wooded areas around wetlands and through tree and shrub collections. Warm up in the lodge-like Oswald Visitor Center.

properties.Name: Gooseberry Falls State Park
properties.Notes: Some easy trails but the majority of trails are suitable for moderate skill level. Trails also include .8 k of difficult trail. The large western loop is groomed for skate-skiing.

properties.Name: Coulee Experimental State Forest
properties.Notes: The Coulee Experimental Forest is about 3000 acres of upland oak forests experimental tree plantings ridgetop open fields rock outcroppings and a few small "goat" prairies on steep topography.

properties.Name: Arrowhead Golf Club
properties.Notes: Golf course skiing in the western suburbs of Chicago.

properties.Name: Carver Park Reserve
properties.Notes: Trails available for beginning to intermediate skiers over a wide variety of terrain from hardwood forests to marshlands.

properties.Name: Solberg Lake Ski Trail
properties.Notes: This a very good trail for the beginning skier. The trail is scenic and passes through both pine and aspen timber.

properties.Name: Seeley Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located just minutes east of Seeley down old Hwy OO.

properties.Name: River Bend
properties.Notes: Trails: 11 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) at River Bend Golf Course. Waskasoo Park also has several trails at Great Chief Park Heritage Ranch and Red Deer College.

properties.Name: Hartley Park
properties.Notes: Trails vary from easy to advanced.

properties.Name: Teton Lakes Golf Course
properties.Notes: A golf course that is privately groomed, low rolling hills, often icy.

properties.Name: Pleasant View Golf Course
properties.Notes: The golf course has groomed ski trails for intermediate to advanced skiers.

properties.Name: Legion Trails
properties.Notes: Rated beginner/intermediate. Located behind the Grand Rapids high school. Maintained by Northern Lights Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond l'Estrel
properties.Notes: Trails: Near the town of Esterel 35 km of cross-country ski trails are groomed for both classic and skating. Of the 10 groomed trails three are rated Easy three Intermediate and four Difficult. Most of the trails are uni-directional so be sure to ski in the direction indicated. There are also some trails for backcountry skiing. In 2009 operation of the trails changed from Esterel resort to Hors Limite Inc. and the center moved to its present location.

properties.Name: Highland 9-hole Golf Course
properties.Notes: Rated beginner to intermediate.

properties.Name: Spirit Mountain
properties.Notes: Beautifully wooded cross-country ski trails double tracked with skating lanes and groomed daily.

properties.Name: Sturgeon River Trails
properties.Notes: Runs through forests above and along side the Sturgeon river.

properties.Name: Bergland Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Lightly used trail system ski thorough many hemlocks with a good mix of hills. All classic.

properties.Name: Saskatoon municipal trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Throughout the city of Saskatoon there are more than 18 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing at several parks and golf courses. The trails range in length from 2 to 5 km and are groomed by the city with the exception of Kinsmen Park which is groomed by Saskatoon Nordic:Kinsmen Park 2 km classic & skating lightedHoliday Park Golf Course 3.5 km classic & skatingWildwood Golf Course 2.5 km classic & skatingLower Meewasin Park 4.8 km classicUpper Meewasin Park 3.4 km classicMeewasin Park to Adilman Buffer 2 km classic

properties.Name: Beatton Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Beatton Provincial Park 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Whiskey Jack Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Mt Rolland
properties.Notes: Trails: Mont-Rolland has several backcountry trails that are part of the Sainte-Adele network and connect to the P'tit Train du Nord linear park.

properties.Name: Hiawatha Highlands
properties.Notes: Trails: Hiawatha Highlands offers 40 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing with some skating trails. A 2 km trail is lighted for night skiing on certain nights.

properties.Name: Nordic Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Part of the Kettle Moraine State Forest - Southern Unit. Rolling to hilly terrain groomed and tracked. New warming shelter and outhouses.

properties.Name: Parc regional du Bois-de-Liesse
properties.Notes: Trails: Bois-de-Liesse Nature Park offers about 22 km of mostly flat trails groomed for cross-country skiing by the city of Montreal.

properties.Name: Lapham Peak
properties.Notes: Located in the Kettle Moraine State Forest the trails wind through wooded hills and open meadows. There is a 3.2K lighted trail with snowmaking.

properties.Name: Chester Bowl
properties.Notes: Cross-country skiing at Chester Bowl offers 3k for the advanced skier and racer. The trail starts at the access and loops counter-clockwise.

properties.Name: Mines of Spain Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Located in on the bluffs overlooking the Mississippi River just south of Dubuque.

properties.Name: Baker Park Reserve
properties.Notes: The trails pass through a nice combination of woods and lakes.

properties.Name: Blind River Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: At Boom Camp 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Blind River Cross Country Ski Club. The trails are mainly single track but some have a skating lane.

properties.Name: Nepco Lake County Park
properties.Notes: Nepco Lake County Park is located one mile south of Wisconsin Rapids on County Z. There are 6.25km (3.8 miles) of ski trails on rolling terrain. All trails are groomed for skate and classic skiing by River Cities Nordic Ski Club. (Submitted by Mike Lauterbach)

properties.Name: Telemark XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Telemark Cross Country Ski Club grooms 35 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 2.5 km lighted for night skiing.

properties.Name: Menihek Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 31 km of trails are snowcat-groomed for cross-country skiing by the Menihek Ski Club including 6 km of lighted trails for night skiing. About 15 km of the trails were designed for racing by ski champion Bill Koch. Menihek hosts the Great Labrador Loppet in late March.

properties.Name: Fit Strip
properties.Notes: Located right in Marquette contains 1.7 and 1 kilometer cross-country ski trails which are lighted until 11 p.m. during the winter months.

properties.Name: Bulkley Valley XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: The Bulkley Valley Cross Country Ski Club grooms 45 km of trails for cross-country skiing with a snowcat groomer for both classic and skating techniques. The centre has 5.5 km of trails lighted for evening skiing. There are trails for all levels of challenge--from easy to advanced. Due to its location the centre has a long ski season (up to 6 months).

properties.Name: Ribbon Creek
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 60 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing near the Nikiska Ski area in the Kananaskis Village/Ribbon Creek section of Kananaskis Country.

properties.Name: Pasadena Ski & Nature Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Pasadena Ski and Nature Park has 18 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.Trails have lots of easy and intermediate sections and some difficult sections. A few of the trails are groomed for skating technique. One of the trails is lighted for night skiing on certain nights.

properties.Name: Governor Nelson State Park
properties.Notes: Located next to Lake Mendota the park features restored prairie and savanna and effigy mounds.

properties.Name: Chassell Trail
properties.Notes: Easy to intermediate level. The hills have been designed to provide ample landing space at the bottom with no surprise corners. 1km lighted trail. Maintained through cooperation from private landholders and The Chassell Recreation Club on a volunteer basis. Parking and the trailhead at the Chassell Heritage Center.

properties.Name: Montreal Trails
properties.Notes: 2km railroad grade makes for great cruising. Other steeper plunges down to the grade. Trails are in the city of Montreal just west of Ironwood/Hurley. Densely wooded and secluded. Donation box. Connects with 19km Uller trail to Whitecap Mtn which is even more remote.

properties.Name: Shanty Creek
properties.Notes: 30K. Excellent grooming, even midweek! Good place to skate or classic.

properties.Name: Ski Martock
properties.Notes: Trails: Martock has 11 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including some trails for skating technique. All the trails have snowmaking. Martock hosted the biathlon and cross-country skiing events for the 2011 Canada Winter Games.

properties.Name: Columbia Golf Course
properties.Notes: Located off Central Ave in the heart of Northeast Minneapolis. One of the oldest golf courses in the Cities. Most of the trail system is on the west side of the park.

properties.Name: Rikert Nordic Center
properties.Notes:
From their homepage: "55+ km of skate and classic skiing, snowshoeing and fat biking nestled in the heart of the Green Mountain National Forest.
 Our trails lead through wonderful forests, old farm fields edged by stonewalls, along babbling brooks, and even past Robert Frost’s Summer Cabin. You’ll quickly understand the inspiration this area has offered to so many.
 The Nordic Center is fully ADA accessible, offers a full service rental shop, and a PSIA certified ski school. Relax and refuel by the warm wood stove, enjoy the great food, warm beverages and a cozy atmosphere."

properties.Name: Spring Lake Park Reserve
properties.Notes: Schaar's Bluff offers groomed ski trails wind through the woods and along the bluffs overlooking the scenic Mississippi River valley.

properties.Name: Lake Maria State Park
properties.Notes: Beginner to intermediate skill level primarily intermediate. Rolling terrain goes through wooded areas old growth forest areas and past lakes and ponds.

properties.Name: Mataquac Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: According to one report Mactaquac Provincial Park no longer groom the 17 km of trails for cross-country skiing and winter activities are not available.

properties.Name: Sun Peaks Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: At Sun Peaks Resort 31 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including some that are groomed for skating. There are another 14 km of ungroomed backcountry trails.

properties.Name: Como Golf Course
properties.Notes: Trails are on the golf course. Some nice hills but most of the course is pretty exposed. There is one back leg that is quite shaded and seems to hold snow long after the rest of the course loses it. Rentals at the chalet.

properties.Name: Love Creek County Park
properties.Notes: 10km total (4k skating, 10k classic), flat to rolling terrain. Grooming is fair (tracks) to good (skating). Grooming is done via snowmobile with track setter.

properties.Name: French Regional Park
properties.Notes: A nice set of trails with rolling hills. The first lighted trail system in the metro it still attracts a lot of after-work skiers.

properties.Name: River Valley Outdoor Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Throughout Edmonton's River Valley 50 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing in nine different parks most of them by the city. Edmonton Nordic Ski Club grooms the trails at Gold bar Park where they operate snowmaking on the trails and offer ski lessons. There are also some ungroomed trails. Trails at three parks are lighted for night skiing.Terwillegar Park - 5 kmWhitemud Park - 3 kmWilliam Hawrelak Park - 3 kmVictoria Park - 3 kmKinsmen Park - 3.5 km lightedMill Creek Park - 5 kmRiverside Golf Course - 5 km + 5 km connector to Capilano Park - 8 km lightedGold Bar Park - 10 km lighted and snowmaking by ENSC

properties.Name: Negaunee Township Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Several loops of groomed trail. Starts at the Negaunee Township Community Center.

properties.Name: Russian Jack Park
properties.Notes: Municipal park that offers novice to intermediate trails mostly along paved trails and a golf course.

properties.Name: Copper Harbor Pathway
properties.Notes: Trails vary from easy to expert including the Kamakazie 9 km Intermediate to Expert loop.

properties.Name: University of Minnesota Golf Course
properties.Notes: The Univ of Minnesota Center for Outdoor Adventure is providing high quality frequently groomed skiing right in the heart of the metro at the Les Bolstad Golf Course.

properties.Name: Hiawatha Golf Course
properties.Notes: Located just off Minnehaha Parkway north of Lake Nokomis.

properties.Name: Penokee Mountain Trail
properties.Notes: In spite of being located in rugged terrain the trail is suitable for skiers of moderate ability. Only the 8.6 Km loop has climbs and down hills that demand intermediate skiing ability.

properties.Name: National Mine Ski Area
properties.Notes: Just west of Ishpeming these trails also have a biathlon range.

properties.Name: Muskeg Creek Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At Muskeg Creek 10 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including some that are groomed for skating. A 1.5 km trail is lighted for night skiing. The centre is the site of the Athabasca Loppet in late January.

properties.Name: Mississippi National Ski Trails
properties.Notes: 8KM groomed for classic 7KM groomed for both classic and skating. The classic loop is one through wooded terrain and offers extensive views of the Mississippi River. The trailhead is located at the Mississippi National Golf Course Parking lot 2 miles south of Red Wing. Also known as Red Wing East End Recreational Area.

properties.Name: Forest History Center
properties.Notes: Interpretive Center ski through 1900's Logging Camp and virgin timber. Rated beginner. Maintained by Northern Lights Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Brown Deer Park
properties.Notes: Trails roll over the golf course and woods.

properties.Name: Lake Kegonsa State Park
properties.Notes: Most of the ski trails are easy to moderate in difficulty. A few have hills with difficult turns.

properties.Name: Landrose Ski Trails/Llyodminster Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: The Lloydminster Ski Club grooms some trails for cross-country skiing at Land Rose. There are also some trails at Llyodminster Golf Club that are groomed for skiing.

properties.Name: Saint Mary's University
properties.Notes: Some of the best trails in southern Minnesota. Tucked in the valley behind the school the trails run around the northern slopes of the valley making them quite challenging and also well protected from the sun. Some lighted sections and snowmaking operations.

properties.Name: Lone Rock Trail
properties.Notes: Groomed trails through gently rolling terrain woodland and agricultural land. Part of the U of M's UMore Park.

properties.Name: Spidahl Ski Gaard
properties.Notes: Spidahl Ski Gard (farm in Norsk) is a private touring center located in sugar maple hills four miles south of Maplewood State Park. It has trails groomed for classical and skate skiing with ski and snowshoe rentals available. The owners Cindy and David Spidahl love to ski and it shows in the trail layout and grooming.

properties.Name: Mount Itasca
properties.Notes: Trail follows glacial moraines and ravines through forest; rated intermediate/expert. Snowmaking loop.

properties.Name: Ney Nature Center
properties.Notes: The Ney Nature Center is a non-profit organization offering environmental education and outdoor recreation opportunities. The Nature Center has 10km of classical ski trails and rentals are available.

properties.Name: Jasper Park Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: Near Jasper Park Lodge are several ungroomed trails suitable for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Battle Creek Regional Park West
properties.Notes: Top notch hilly and twisting course through prairie and woods. There are 4K of lighted trails. Parking lot located off Winthrop St. Ski Games trail segment is located on west side of Battle Creek Rd.

properties.Name: Washburn Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located near Rhinelander these trails provide a good variety of terrain.

properties.Name: Ski BenEoin
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) at the Ski Ben Eoin resort. Most of the trails are at the top of the mountain and accessed by chairlift.

properties.Name: Crabbe Mountain
properties.Notes: Trails: More than 30 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing adjacent to the Ski Crabbe Mountain alpine ski centre. They are grouped in three networks:

properties.Name: Lowes Creek County Park
properties.Notes: Trails are rolling to hilly and are found on both sides of Lowes Creek.

properties.Name: Beauvais Lake Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Beauvais Lake Provincial Park has 13 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing. Several trails lead to viewpoints.

properties.Name: Mt. Valhalla Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Teuton trails on the west side is skating and classic the Valkyrie trails on the east side are double tracked for classic only skiing.

properties.Name: Black's Grove Park
properties.Notes: The park consists of virgin pine and hardwood forest covering a nice variety of terrain with a pristine stream Oak Creek winding through it. Park amenities also include a log shelter with fireplace.

properties.Name: Bois Duvernay
properties.Notes: Trails: Bois Duvernay nature park offers more than 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Coureurs des Boises. The trails are mainly classic tracks with the exception of one 8 km that is groomed for skating.

properties.Name: Mountain View Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Flowing trails with moderate hills through the woods. Groomed by local volunteers. Opened winter 2009-10.

properties.Name: Wood Lake Nature Center
properties.Notes: A beautiful little nature preserve right in the middle of Richfield.

properties.Name: Montebello Trail
properties.Notes: Located in the heart of the city of Bemidji close to many hotels and restaurants. Two km of lighted track. Ideal trail for beginners.

properties.Name: Gronlid Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: The Melfort Cross Country Ski Club grooms 20 km of trails for cross-country skiing near Gronlid including a 2 km lighted trail for night skiing. About half the trails are rated Easy the rest Intermediate.

properties.Name: Bunker Hills Regional Park
properties.Notes: Flat to slightly hilly terrain trail loops. A 12K skijoring loop has been added in recent years.

properties.Name: Phalen Golf Course
properties.Notes: Most of the trails are on the golf course thus pretty open and fairly flat. The course really winds back and forth.

properties.Name: Logan Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At Logan Lake 36 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) by the Highland Valley Outdoor Association including 2 km of lighted trails for night skiing.

properties.Name: Forest Springs Camp
properties.Notes: A trail system with a variable terrain. 12 loop trails mostly 1 to 2 km in length and varying from easy to quite difficult. Wooded groomed almost daily averaging 12 ft wide.

properties.Name: Les Sources Joyeuses de la Malbaie
properties.Notes: Trails: Les Sources Joyeuses outdoor centre offers 35 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 6 km for skating. The centre is operated by a not-for-profit organization with the aid of the municipality. It is situated in the Charlevoix meteor crater the seventh largest in the world.

properties.Name: Caledonia Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Otway Nordic Centre offers 40 km of trails that are snowcat groomed for cross-country skiing by the Caledonia Nordic Ski Club including 5 km that are lighted for night skiing. There are more ungroomed trails at Tabor Mountain on the other side of Prince George.

properties.Name: Rockport Park
properties.Notes: Largest park in the Janesville area. Groomed by Friends of Rockport Park.

properties.Name: Echo Valley Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Echo Valley Provincial Park has 10 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. There are two Easy trails (4 km) one Intermediate (5 km) and one Expert (1.2 km).

properties.Name: Club de Six Cantons
properties.Notes: Trails: The Club de ski de fond les Six Cantons groom 43 km of trails for cross-country skiing. Four trails are rated Easy three are Intermediate and six are Difficult.

properties.Name: Chain of Lakes
properties.Notes: This trail is groomed across the chain of lakes in Minneapolis: Brownie Cedar (including Cedar Lake Park) Lake of the Isles and Lake Calhoun. Usually not groomed until mid-winter once the ice is safe for vehicles.

properties.Name: Dunton Locks Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Mixture of trails with hilly segments and more gentle terrain. Located just west of big Detroit Lake.

properties.Name: Washburn Lake Solitude Area Trails
properties.Notes: Located in the Land O'Lakes State Forest the trails are rated novice to expert.

properties.Name: Upper Gunflint Trail
properties.Notes: 45 miles north of Grand Marais. Large system near Canadian border and BWCA. Good mix of terrain with lots of overlooks. Many trails for classical with limited skating (roughly 30K). Three trailside lodges (Gunflint Lodge Gunflint Pines Resort Hestons Resort).

properties.Name: Sylvan Hill Park
properties.Notes: Rated beginner to intermediate. The trails are hilly and wooded and meander through Sylvan Hill Park. Parking is available in the Sylvan Chalet parking lot.

properties.Name: Sugarloaf Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Sugarloaf Provincial Park 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by Les Montagnards Ski Club. The 4 km Terry Fox Trail circles around the base of the mountain. All other trails are at the top of the mountain accessible by car or by chairlift. The Montagnards Ski Club is based at the park.

properties.Name: Lodi Area Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Skate and classic trail on Lakeland Hills Golf Course and adjoining farm fields along woods maintained and groomed by Lodi XC Ski Club. Trail head is on Strangway Ave at the northeast corner of Lakeland Hills. Trails include several mostly open loops for beginner through advanced skiers including a 120ft vertical climb.

properties.Name: VASA Trail
properties.Notes: 25+ K groomed classic & skating. Michigan Cup race site.

properties.Name: Chickakoo Lake Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Chickakoo Lake Recreation Area offers 14 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. There are lots of single track some double track some skating lanes. See the Edmonton Nordic Ski Guide for a more detailed description.

properties.Name: Turtle River State Park
properties.Notes: Nice little park groomed for skating and classic when there is enough snow.

properties.Name: Silver Rapids Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Rated beginner to intermediate. Trails have scenic overlooks of Farm Lake and connect to Hidden Valley Trails.

properties.Name: CAVOC Trails
properties.Notes: Cedric A. Vig Outdoor Classroom trails known more as CAVOC. Advanced beginner to expert hilly terrain rarely any flat terrain.

properties.Name: Prince Albert National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: There are about 150 km of trails throughout Prince Albert National Park that are groomed for cross-country skiing.The trails are mainly single-track classic several are double track. Four are groomed for skating and classic (90 km total).Trail rating: Some difficult sections lots of intermediate sections lots of easy sections

properties.Name: Murphy-Hanrehan Park Reserve
properties.Notes: Expert only trails. Some of the most exciting and challenging trails in the metro. They need a really good snow cover to be open.

properties.Name: Wascana Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Regina has 8.7 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing by the Regina Ski Club. The trails are located in four separate locations around Wascana Centre (the city's central park).

properties.Name: Token Creek County Park
properties.Notes: Located just NE of Madison and a short distance from I-90.

properties.Name: Central Gunflint Trail System
properties.Notes: Well groomed trail system near Minnesota's Boundary Waters Canoe Area. Good mix of terrain for all levels of skiers. Grooming caters to classical skiers but skating available (roughly 60K). 1.5-2K lighted sections at two trailside lodges (Bearskin and Golden Eagle). 27 miles north of Grand Marais.

properties.Name: Pigeon Creek
properties.Notes: 16 K of groomed x-c ski trails with diagonal skating lanes, 2 K of lighted x-c ski trails, sledding hill, x-c ski rentals and warming lodge.

properties.Name: Lappe Nordic Ski Center
properties.Notes: Trails: The Lappe Nordic Club grooms 12 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 5 km of lighted trails for night skiing. The club hosts a Wednesday night race series and a 24-Hour Relay ski race in late March. Lappe Nordic was the site of the 2006 National Cross Country Ski Championships.

properties.Name: Muskegon Winter Sports Complex
properties.Notes:
There are two artificially lighted cross country ski trails with lengths of 2.5 kilometers and 5.0 kilometers respectively; a 3.5 kilometer expert trail; and, a 4.0 kilometer "natural classical" only trail.Trails are groomed daily for both classical and skate skiing. 
 
 The trail winds through dense forests dominated by white pines which have often referred to as the "enchanted forest" after a snowfall. The "quiet" skier often encounters local wildlife, such as whitetail deer, ruffled grouse, squirrel, or the growing population of wild turkey.

properties.Name: Pine Valley
properties.Notes: Excellent trail with challenging terrain. It has difficult climbs as well as gradual rolling sections. Part of the system is lit from 4:30 to 9:30 all winter. Located adjacent to Cloquet area recreation center (hockey rink) south of Pine Tree Plaza.

properties.Name: Nubs Nob
properties.Notes: 27K of groomed and tracked cross country including a 2K lit loop at night. See Chestnut Valley above for a connecting trail map.

properties.Name: Kamview Nordic Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Kamview Nordic Centre offers 28 km of trails groomed by Pisten Bully for classic and skating cross-country skiing including 5.5 km lighted for night skiing. The trails are maintained by Thunder Bay Nordic Trails Association.

properties.Name: Triangle XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: The Triangle Cross-Country Ski Club grooms 17 km of trails for cross-country skiing plus there are also backcountry trails.

properties.Name: Yellowknife Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 14 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. The club hosted the 2003 Western Canadian Cross Country Ski Championships. Two km of trails are lighted for night skiing.

properties.Name: Champs de Bataille
properties.Notes: Trails: There are about 14 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing on the historic Plains of Abraham battlefield. Four trails are rated easy one is intermediate.

properties.Name: Blue Mountains Nordic Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: About 22 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skate techniques) at Scenic Caves Nordic Centre near Blue Mountain Ski Resort.

properties.Name: Club de Ski de Beauce
properties.Notes: Trails: The Club de Ski de Beauce grooms 34 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: CLCF Nordic
properties.Notes: Challenging two way loops in the Kettle Moraine region in a 145 acre nature conservancy. Cedar Lakes Conservation Foundation (CLCF) owns the land and allows for the cross-country ski trails in the winter. CLCF Nordic is entirely maintained by memberships and volunteers. Trails formerly known as Fox Hill Nordic.

properties.Name: Kane Valley Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: The Kane Valley Ski Trails total 50 km in length 40 km of which are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Nicola Nordic Ski Club. There are lots of single track trails some double track and some skating lane. Trails range from easy to difficult. Dogs are permitted on several of the trails.

properties.Name: Willow River State Park
properties.Notes: Trails range from easy such as the Purple Trail running along the Willow River to the challenging Brown and Silver trails. Trails are groomed for both classical and skate skiing. All grooming is done by volunteer groomers who pride themselves in providing the best possible conditions.

properties.Name: Bear Mountain XC Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 23 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Bear Mountain Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Lester Park
properties.Notes: The Lester-Amity trail offers 15K of varied terrain for beginner to experienced skiers through pine aspen and birch forests. An additional 3K circles the Lester Park Golf Course and is accessible from the main Lester-Amity Trail. The openness of the golf course offers an excellent place for beginning cross-country skiers and several short cuts are available. There is also a 5K trail portion that is lit in the mornings and evenings.

properties.Name: McCulloch Lakes Ski Center
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 60 km of trails at McCulloch Lakes are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Kelowna Nordic Ski Club. There is also 15 km of ungroomed trails and a canine trail. The club offers moonlight ski tours and guided snowshoe trips.

properties.Name: Greenbush Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located in the Kettle Moraine North State Forest these are some of the best known trails in SE Wisconsin. Heated shelter and sledding hill too. Roughly 2K of lighted trail.

properties.Name: Telemark Resort Trails
properties.Notes: Some of the most famous trails in the area! The American Birkie starts here and the Korteloppet makes extensive use of the trail system.

properties.Name: Suomi Hills
properties.Notes: Trail runs through rolling hills and lakes with maple basswood and aspen forest. Connections with Amen Lake Trail. Rated intermediate/expert.

properties.Name: Flathorn-Gegoka Trails
properties.Notes: Mostly single tracked through the quiet tall pines past peaceful lakes of Superior National Forest.

properties.Name: Elm Creek Park Reserve
properties.Notes: Some of the best ski trails in the metro area. Fantastic night skiing on their lighted trails! New in 2003 a 2.5K man-made snow loop.

properties.Name: Marathon International Ski
properties.Notes: Trails: Marathon Cross Country Ski Club grooms 15 km of trails for cross-country skiing (classic and skating) including 5 km of trails that are lighted for night skiing. The club hosts the Marathon Loppet in mid-January.

properties.Name: William O'Brien State Park
properties.Notes: A wonderful course mainly in the woods with a number of good hills.

properties.Name: Omineca Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Omineca Ski Club grooms 25 km of trails for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) including a 2 km trail lighted for night skiing.

properties.Name: Wild River State Park
properties.Notes: With trails from beginners to expert and a very modern heated trail center Wild River State Park is one of the hidden gems for cross-country skiing in eastern Minnesota. The Aspen Knob loop is extremely challenging.

properties.Name: Deer Grove Forest Preserve
properties.Notes: Mature oak and maple forests and hilly terrain at Deer Grove offers excellent skiing and the wooded areas provide protection from the wind on cold days.

properties.Name: Lebanon Hills Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails wind through the hilly wooded countryside and around scenic lakes and ponds. Nearly all trails are classic only -- skating only allowed on trails at the West Trailhead.

properties.Name: Minooka Park
properties.Notes: Has dependable grooming and track setting and holds snow well due to grooming and trail layout. Some problems with hikers. Trail hub is 3rd parking lot. Long loop is moderately hilly with long inclines/declines. Out-Houses only.

properties.Name: Blueberry Hills
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate/expert.

properties.Name: Cleary Lake Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails range from beginner to intermediate level. 6.8km of the trails are lighted daily until 10 p.m..

properties.Name: McMiller
properties.Notes: Part of the Southern Kettle Moraine State Forest. The trails pass through hardwoods forest and pine plantations. Five trails of different distances and degrees of difficulty greet skiers of all abilities.

properties.Name: Nipika Lodge & Touring Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Nipika Mountain Resort offers 50 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (double-track and skating) ranging from easy to difficult. The resort hosts the Nipika Loppet in late January.

properties.Name: French Rapids Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Some incredible climbs and descents. Offers stunning views of the Mississippi River. Mainly expert trails.

properties.Name: Trout Lake Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Located in the Chippewa National Forest semi-primitive. Contains Joyce Estate a historic northwoods retreat with log and stone buildings of Adirondack architecture. Rated beginner/intermediate.

properties.Name: Allison-Chinook
properties.Notes: Trails: Allison-Chinook at the foot of Mount Tecumseh has 31 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing by the Crowsnest Pass Cross Country Ski Association. Most of the trails are rated Easy or Intermediate. The trails are mainly singletrack but there a few double track and skating sections.

properties.Name: Superior Municipal Forest
properties.Notes: Trails groomed for classical and skate skiing. Trail fee required.

properties.Name: Blackhawk Ski Club Trails
properties.Notes: Easy trails for beginners by the East Chalet that run through a stand of white pines and steeper and longer trails that go down Hill #6 around the 60m ski jump and up to the top of Hill #2. Blackhawk trails also connect with longer trails on Pleasant View Golf Course. Some snowmaking operations and lit trails.

properties.Name: Copper Falls State Park
properties.Notes: Rolling terrain including some scenic sections along the Bad River.

properties.Name: Kawartha Nordic Ski Club Trail
properties.Notes: Trails: The Kawartha Nordic Ski Club grooms 48 km of interlinked trails for cross-country skiing including 14 km for skating technique. There are some difficult and intermediate sections of trails and lots of easy sections. The outer perimeter trail is about 18 km in length. First aid and ski patrol are provided on weekends.

properties.Name: Birch Brook Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Birch Brook Nordic Ski Club grooms 10 trails totalling 35 km for cross-country skiing. The trails range in length up to 10 km and are rated mainly intermediate with some easy advanced sections. The trails are mainly double track and some are groomed for skating technique. Birch Brook is the site of the annual Big Land Loppet in late March or early April.

properties.Name: Stokely Creek Ski Touring Center
properties.Notes: Trails: Stokely Creek Lodge offers 95 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing with some skating lanes. There are also 40 km of backcountry trails. The resort is in the "lake effect" snowbelt and attracts many skiers from the US Midwest.Stokely Creek is the site of the annual Wabos Loppet in late March where the participants start with an hour-long train ride then ski 26 km back to the lodge.

properties.Name: Andes Tower Hill Ski Area
properties.Notes: Nice variety of terrain on mostly wooded trails adjacent to commercial ski area. Both classical and skating tracks. On some Saturdays breakfast is served at a warming house halfway down the trail--call for availability. 1.5km lighted.

properties.Name: Tilson Creek Ski Trail
properties.Notes: The ski trail crosses open and forested bog and passes through stands of aspen spruce balsam fir and eastern white cedar. The terrain varies from flat bog to rolling uplands and steep rock ridges. Whitetail deer use areas along the trail for winter yarding. Moose timber wolves and pine martens are occationally seen along the trail. Located in Koochiching State Forest.

properties.Name: High Point Cross Country Ski Center
Boyne Nordican
properties.Notes: 50K groomed skating & classic. Hilly trail system, good grooming. Occasionally an alpine skier to ski down Grinder (the main route to the top) and mess up trail. Michigan Cup race site.

properties.Name: Nordic Ridge Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Trailhead is at the Crosslake Community Center.

properties.Name: Stake Lake Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: The Overlander Ski Club grooms 49 km of trails at Stake Lake for cross-country skiing (skate and classic). The base elevation is 1270 metres (4100 feet).

properties.Name: Camp Mercier
properties.Notes: Trails: Camp Mercier offers 52 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including about 12 km for skating. One trail connects with those of Forat Montmorency. A 65-km backcountry trail connects with Mont-Sainte-Anne and has two huts along its path. Another two backcounry networks in nearby Parc de la Jacques-Cartier have six huts along the trails. This area generally has the best snowfall in the southern half of the province.

properties.Name: Movil Maze Trail
properties.Notes: This steep hilly area is the favorite training ground of local racers. Trail is through black spruce bogland red pine and mixed hardwood. Great rolling hills and sweeping corners -- entirely in the woods.

properties.Name: Blueberry Ridge Trail
properties.Notes: Part of the DNR Forest with a 2.7km lighted loop. Trails range from easy to advanced with some classical-only trails.

properties.Name: Herrick Lake Forest Preserve
properties.Notes: Machine-grooming by DuPage FPD on regular basis when sufficient snow is available. Most trails are double-tracked with a narrow skating lane between. Ski rentals are available at Arrowhead Golf Course on the east side.

properties.Name: Alder Pond
properties.Notes: Ski through young aspen and hardwood forest. Wildlife is abundant in this area so don’t be surprised to find small natural visitors sharing the trail with you. Please stay on the trail as some of the area is private property.

properties.Name: Boulder Lake Management Area Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located 18 miles north of Duluth the groomed trails are in nice primitive outdoor setting. The trails feature the "Wolfski's Ski Den" warming shack open daily sunrise to sunset. In addition to the 21 kilometers of classical skiing there will also be 11 kilometers groomed for skate-skiing. Trails are groomed Fridays and Mondays and/or as needed. No fee or Minnesota State Ski Pass is required.

properties.Name: Nordic Woods
properties.Notes: Mostly intermediate level trails are groomed for classical or both classic and skating. There is also a beginner loop. Skating sections tend to be quite narrow and the trail is remote and heavily wooded. Ideal classical terrain.

properties.Name: Cascade River State Park
properties.Notes: Trails for beginner to intermediate.

properties.Name: Three Eagle Trail
properties.Notes: The trail is about 8km long and traverses a bridge and two boardwalks. It traverses wetlands woodlands and crosses a stream in flat to gently rolling easy terrain. There is a parking lot for skiers at the north end of the trail on Sundstein Road.

properties.Name: Sugarbush Trail System
properties.Notes: A wide variety of trails are found in this extensive system winding through varied forests and offering many spectacular views. Trailheads include Britton Peak and Moose Fence on the western side with ski-throughs connecting these sections to the Onion River Rd/Oberg Mountain trails and trailhead on the eastern edge.

properties.Name: Mt MacPherson XC Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At Mt MacPherson 22 km of trail are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Revelstoke Nordic Ski Club. The trails are groomed by snowcat for both classic and skating techniques.Trail rating: lots of difficult and intermediate sections some easy sections. A lantern-lighted ski tour is held twice each season.

properties.Name: Stony Creek Metropark
properties.Notes: Cross Country Ski Touring Center (Golf Course) has marked trails, rental equipment and weekend food service

properties.Name: Callaghan Country
properties.Notes: Trails: Callaghan Country is a luxurious full-service backcountry lodge with 40 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing. The trails connect with those of the Whistler Olympic Park site of the nordic events for the 2010 Olympic Winter Games. Day skiers can purchase a combined pass good for both trail systems which together offer a total of more than 90 km of trails.Callaghan Country has lots of singletrack trails and some double track and skating. There are some difficult sections of trails lots of intermediate sections and some easy sections.The surrounding Coast Mountain Range provides lots of opportunities for backcountry touring and telemarking. Guided backcountry trips can be arranged through the lodge.CAUTION: Anyone planning on backcountry trips should be knowledgeable and experienced in backcountry travel and avalanche safety.

properties.Name: Banadad Trail
properties.Notes: 32 miles north of Grand Marais. Groomed single track backcountry trail in BWCA Wilderness that connects Central Gunflint Trails with Upper Gunflint Trails. Yurt to Yurt skiing available.

properties.Name: Lake Bemidji State Park
properties.Notes: Nice classical trails some close to the shore of Lake Bemidji while rest is deep in the woods. Site of Candlelight ski tours and annual Volkslauf ski race.

properties.Name: Holy Cross Ski Trail
properties.Notes: This is a very scenic trail system with moderately hilly and rolling terrain through a variety of timber types. Excellent family trail tour.

properties.Name: Sleeping Giant/Sibley P.P.
properties.Notes: Trails: At Sleeping Giant Provincial Park from 20 to 50 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Thunder Bay Nordic Trails Association. The park is the site of the annual Sleeping Giant Loppet in early March.There is a 10 km beginner loop an 18 km intermediate and 18 & 29 km loops for advanced skiers.

properties.Name: Bird Lake Trail
properties.Notes: Trail meanders through northwoods country with black spruce bogs and hills of aspen and birch. Most of the trail is for beginners and intermediate skiers. Two trailheads offer access.

properties.Name: Nelson Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 25 km of trails are groomed by Pisten Bulley for cross-country skiing by the Nelson Nordic Ski Club. A 1.3 km loop is lighted for night skiing. The centre hosts the Annual Kootenay Cup fun race in early March. Another 20 km of trails are nearby at Whitewater Ski Area.

properties.Name: Trezona Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Rated easy for beginner skiers. Trails are easily accessible in the town of Ely.

properties.Name: Pincushion Mountain Trail
properties.Notes: Well designed trail 2 miles north of Grand Marais. Dependable classical and skating grooming by dedicated ski club. Gentle rolling beginner and intermediate terrain through birch aspen and pine forest with expert options. Nice overlooks of North Shore far below. Separate snowshoe trail. Public warming building. 1.6 K lighted xc trail on each night.

properties.Name: Bally Creek Trails
properties.Notes: Primarily classical trails with an 8K segment off the FR 158 trailhead. Connects into Moose Trail and Cascade River State Park.

properties.Name: Aurora Nordic
properties.Notes: Trails: The Aurora Nordic ski club maintains 12 km of trail: lots of single track and skating trails some difficult sections lots of intermediate sections some easy sections. A 2.5 km trail is lighted for night skiing on certain evenings.

properties.Name: Korkki Nordic
properties.Notes: Korkki Nordic Center is a secluded trail just east of Duluth consisting of a single-track classical trail. Wicked hills flats downs...it has everything. Trails were designed for racing and are recommended for those with at least intermediate to advanced classical skiing skills.

properties.Name: Blow Me Down Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: More than 40 km of trails are snowcat-groomed for cross-country skiing by the Blow-Me-Down Ski Club. Seven km of trails are lighted for night skiing on certain nights. Trails are located on a plateau 300 metres above Corner Brook and receive more snow than in town (4.5 metres per year). The club hosts the annual Blow Me Down Loppet in early March.

properties.Name: WinMan Trails
properties.Notes: Mix of skate and classic trails over rolling terrain.

properties.Name: Raven Trails
properties.Notes: The trails wind past Clear Hemlock and Inkpot Lake. There are a couple of steep hills and most of the trails require intermediate skiing abilities. There is also a four mile expert trail (red loop). A shelter with a fire ring can be found on the trail.

properties.Name: Woodland Trails
properties.Notes: Maintained by Elk River Nordic Nordic Ski Club these trails have become a hot-spot for fantastic skiing in the North Metro. Trails are largely wooded over rolling terrain but some sections have good climbs and descents. Trails consist of several interconnected loops and are aptly named--be sure to check out the "Top-of-the-World" and "Gravity Box" as well as "Wash Pond Flats" to the NE of the biathlon range. There is not a warming shack but at least one port-o-potty at the main parking lot. Primarily groomed for skate (not always tracked for classic).

properties.Name: Madeline Lake Trail
properties.Notes: This trail has a variety of scenery as it winds around three lakes and through different types of terrain. It has a few rolling hills. Most of the trail follows old logging roads. This is an excellent trail for skiers of all abilities. There is a shelter located on the trail with a fire ring.

properties.Name: Howard Wagoner Trail
properties.Notes: The City of Tower Howard Wagoner ski trails consist of mainly beginner and intermediate trails that wind through a beautiful and peaceful red and white pine forest. There is a short lighted loop (1.3K) for night skiing. Minnesota ski pass is required.

properties.Name: Nine Mile County Forest Recreation Area
properties.Notes: One of the top trails in NE Wisconsin. Trails are generally one-way and double-tracked (skate and classic). The ski chalet offers a changing area ski and snowshoe equipment rentals daily and annual trail passes and restrooms. There roughly 6K of lighted trails and programmed to go on at dusk until 9 pm. Trail difficulty ranges from beginner to difficult.

properties.Name: Afton State Park
properties.Notes: Trails range from beginner to advanced.

properties.Name: Biskey Ponds Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Scenic trails rated from easy to advanced located in Fredenberg Township Minnesota.

properties.Name: Mother Bear Ski Trail
properties.Notes: This is a remote trail that is groomed by volunteers for classic skiing that goes thru jackpine forests black spruce swamps and over glacial eskers. A skier will probably see more tracks of deer wolves and moose that they will of other skiers. A snowshoe trail is also starts by the trailhead. Located two miles south of Hellman's Store on CR 44.

properties.Name: Whitehorse Cross Country Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: At Mount McIntyre there are 60 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing by the Whitehorse Cross Country Ski Club plus there are also some backcountry trails. A 5-km trail is lighted for night skiing on weeknights. There are some single track some double track lots of skating lane. Trail ratings: some difficult sections lots of intermediate sections some easy sections. Trails are patrolled. The centre hosts the Yukon Loppet in early March and was the site of the cross-country events of the 2007 Canada Winter Games.There are also 10 km of trails at Log Cabin on the road to Skagway which are often groomed by the Skagway Ski Club and are the site of the annual Buckwheat Classic.

properties.Name: Paulson XC Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At the Paulson Cross Country ski area 45 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (mainly classic technique) by the Castlegar Nordic Ski Club. Trails are single and double track for recreational and advanced skiers.

properties.Name: White Butte Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: White Butte offers 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing both classic and skating and are rated easy to intermediate. The trails are maintained by the Regina Ski Club and are the site of the annual Regina Ski Club Loppet in February.

properties.Name: Northwoods Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Beautiful wooded single track classical trail just outside of Silver Bay. Connecting trail to Tettegouche State Park.

properties.Name: Big Aspen Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Over 30k of trails rated for beginners to intermediate skiers. A couple of nice shelters plus a beautiful overlook.

properties.Name: China Ridge XC Ski Association
properties.Notes: Trails: China Ridge Cross-Country Ski Association grooms 45 km of trails for cross-country skiing plus there are another 19 km of backcountry trails including a trail for skiing or snowshoeing with your dog. Of the groomed trails approximately 20% are rated Beginner 40% Intermediate 40% Advanced and an additional 4 km loop is assigned double black diamond.

properties.Name: Tettegouche State Park
properties.Notes: All trails rated moderate to difficult.

properties.Name: North Bay Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 50 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the North Bay Nordic Ski Club including 36 km of skating lanes and 2 km of lighted trails for night skiing. The club hosts the annual Blue Sky Loppet in early March.There are also several km of trails in North Bay at the Environmental Centre near Canadore College.

properties.Name: North End Ski Trail
properties.Notes: One loop with two shorter cutoffs. Degree of difficulty: Intermediate. Also includes part of the old Telemark World Cup trail.

properties.Name: Tennessee Pass
properties.Notes: awesome ski chalet with snacks and bar

properties.Name: Lake Elmo Park Reserve
properties.Notes: Mix of woods and open prairie over rolling terrain. All trails are groomed skate and classic. Almost 9K of lighted trails.

properties.Name: Les Sentiers du Moulin
properties.Notes: Trails: At Les Sentiers du Moulin 38 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including 10 km for skating technique. Trails link with those of Le Refuge.

properties.Name: Pike Lake Unit
properties.Notes: Groomed cross-country ski trails in the Kettle Moraine State Forest. A warming shelter with fireplace is available in the south picnic area.

properties.Name: Manning Park Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Manning Park Resort offers 30 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including some for skating technique. Six of the ten groomed trails are rated Easiest two are More Difficult and two are Most Difficult. Another 160 km of backcountry trails are also available throughout the park. The resort hosts the Cascade Cup Marathon in early March.

properties.Name: Silver Star Mountain Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: At Silver Star 60 km of trails groomed for skate and classic link with those of Sovereign Lake to make a combined total of more than 100 km. Due to its high elevation (1660 m or 5500 feet) the area receives up to 7 metres (23 feet) of snow annually so is an ideal location for the early season training camps that take place in November and early December.

properties.Name: Mt. Ashwabay Ski Trails
properties.Notes: A great mix of beginner and expert ski trails. With the inclusion of the Jerry Jolly Trails there is about 25 km groomed for skating and classic. There is also an additional 15 km of classic only trails. With views of Lake Superior and the Apostle Islands this is a very scenic area to ski. There is a nice lodge which sells snacks and food as well as a ski patrol and small downhill area.

properties.Name: Larch Hills Ski Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Larch Hills Ski Area offers more than 40 km of trails groomed by Pisten-Bully for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) as well as about 80 km of backcountry trails. LHSC hosts several events: the Turkey Glide Santa Cruise "Moonlight and Valentine" Lantern Skis and the popular Reino Keski-Salmi Loppet.

properties.Name: Giants Ridge
properties.Notes: A system intially developed for intensive training by the USSA Ski Team presents long gradual grades spectacular vistas and roller coaster rides and a variety of challenges for beginners through accomplished skiers. Trails weave through the Superior National Forest.

properties.Name: Mecca
properties.Notes: Trails are on rolling glacial terrain through pine spruce and tamarack forests. A heated chalet with a vault toilet wax bench and changing room is located at the Cabin trailhead. There is a second trailhead at the Little Turtle Flowage parking lot.

properties.Name: Souris Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: About 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skating) by the Souris Striders Ski Club. Trails range from intermediate to difficult in four loops: 1.5 km 3 km 6 km and 7.5 km. Three km of trails are lighted for night skiing every evening.

properties.Name: Forbush Corner
properties.Notes: 38K groomed skating & classic. A wide variety of terrain. Many trail changes this year.

properties.Name: Boyne Highlands
properties.Notes: 28K, 4 Loops. Groomed for skating & striding. Terrain is hilly to flat.

properties.Name: Wintergreen Ski Trail
properties.Notes: This is a very scenic trail as it passes through a diverse forest of pine aspen birch balsam fir and northern hardwoods. There is a warming house at the trailhead.

properties.Name: Jay Cooke State Park
properties.Notes: Easy to difficult trails. The farther you get from the park office the more difficult the trail.

properties.Name: Whitnall Park
properties.Notes: Trails run through the woods and over the fairways of Whitnall Park Golf Course.

properties.Name: Nakkertok Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Nakkertok Ski Club grooms 80 km of trails for cross-country skiing by snowcat of which 2 km are lighted for night skiing. The trails are located in two separate areas North and South connected by a 24 km backcountry trail. With over 1000 members the centre is very popular with capital region families. The club hosts the annual Nakkerloppet and other races.

properties.Name: Rib Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Ranging from the Beginners Loop to the Championship Trail the trail system has been designed to encourage the novice and challenge the expert. Well-behaved pets are welcome on the trail system.

properties.Name: Marsh Lake Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. The centre hosts the annual Marsh Lake Loppet in February.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Porcupine Ski Runners
properties.Notes: Trails: The Porcupine Ski Runners Club grooms 30 km of trails for cross-country skiing (classic and skating). Trails range from easy to difficult. There are 4 km of trails lighted for night skiing (see website for schedule).

properties.Name: Camrose Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: The Camrose Nordic Centre has 30 km of trail that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Camrose Ski Club at the nordic centre and Camrose Golf Course. Two trails totalling 3.5 km are lighted for night skiing. The centre is the site of the annual Ole Uffda Loppet.

properties.Name: One Hundred Mile Nordic Ski Society
properties.Notes: Trails: One Hundred Mile Nordic Ski Society grooms 50 km of trails for cross-country skiing at the 99 Mile Ski centre. The centre has 5 km of trails lighted for night skiing and features racing loops of 2.5 3.5 5 7.5 10 and 20 km and a stadium.A trail links the 99 Mile trail system with the Red Coach Trails. The trails are part of the 150-km network around 100 Mile House and are the site of the annual Cariboo Ski Marathon.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont-Megantic
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc du Mont-Megantic has 38 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are also some backcountry trails. Due to its elevation in the Appalachian foothills this area generally receives the greatst snowfall in southern Quebec.

properties.Name: Standing Rocks Park
properties.Notes: Lots of hills make this an intermediate to expert trail system. Snowmaking 1K loop.

properties.Name: Big White Ski Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: At Big White Ski Resort 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are also some backcountry trails.

properties.Name: Moose Mountain Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Moose Mountain Provincial Park offers 55 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing for both classic and skate skiing. Most of the trails are in the Little Kenosee Trail System west of the riding academy. Several trails are also at the golf course. There are three Easy trails totalling 10 km four Intermediate (28 km) and four Expert (20 km). A 3 km lighted trail in Fish Creek Campground is groomed for classic and skate skiing.

properties.Name: Highlands Nordic
properties.Notes: Trails: At Highlands Nordic 25 km of trails on the Niagara Escarpment are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skate). A 2.5 km trail is lighted one night a week. The centre is located in the "lake effect" snowbelt so receives lots of snow. The Leprechaun Loppet is held in late March.

properties.Name: Whaleback Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Whaleback Nordic's 40 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. Several km of trail are lighted for night skiing on certain evenings. Whaleback hosts the Snowy Owl Classic in late January and was the site of the 2008 Newfoundland and Labrador Cross Country Ski Marathon.

properties.Name: Black Jack XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: About 30 km of trails are groomed for all levels of cross-country skiers by the Black Jack Cross Country Ski Club. The centre hosts the annual Black Jack Loppet in February.

properties.Name: Centre de ski Duchesnay
properties.Notes: Trails: Duchesnay resort grooms 57 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 13 km for skating technique. The government-operated resort is also a forest research facility.

properties.Name: Nickel Plate XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Approxiamtely 56 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing with a Pisten Bully by the Nickel Plate Cross Country Ski Club. The trails are above 1860 metres so receive plenty of snow. The club hosts the annual Nickel Plate Loppet in early February.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont-Orford
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc du Mont-Orford offers more than 50 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including some trails at the Jouvence outdoor centre adjacent to the north end of the network. Twenty-five km of trails in the park are groomed for skating. Eighteen km of trails are rated Easy 11 km are More Difficult and 26 km are Most Difficult. The Orford ski club hosts the Orford Loppet in early February.

properties.Name: Flambeau Hills Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Very scenic with views of the Flambeau River and a heavily timbered landscape. Portions of the upper loop and cutoffs on the east side of the lower loop are more challenging. There is a three-sided shelter on the west side of the upper loop.

properties.Name: Mount Shark
properties.Notes: Trails: At Mount Shark there is a network of 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing and biathlon. There are also backcountry trails in this Spray Lakes area of Kananaskis Country including one to Mt Assiniboine Provincial Park in BC. Caution: Check avalanche reports and carry avalanche rescue equipment

properties.Name: MacDonald Pass Cross Country Ski Trails
Huron Hills Cross Country Ski Center
properties.Notes: Several short groomed trails, classic and skating. Frequently, there is skiable snow in the back bowl when the ground is bare everywhere else. Many people ski here after work - there are enough city lights to see where you're going in the dark.

properties.Name: Mt. Brighton
properties.Notes: Buy a rope tow pass, ski around the base of the slopes to warm up, then start climbing those hills. See if you can beat the chairlift up! Or get a group of people together & setup a slalom course (go up & down it).

properties.Name: Sandy McNabb
properties.Notes: Trails: About 37 km of trail are groomed for cross-country skiing in the Sandy McNabb/Sheep Valley Provincial Park section of Kananaskis Country.

properties.Name: West Bragg Creek
properties.Notes: Trails: In the Elbow Valley section of Kananaskis Country 45 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Hawk Ridge Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Hawk Ridge Centre is no longer operating as a cross-country ski centre. The following info is no longer applicable. If the centre resumes operations please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Canada Olympic Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Canada Olympic Park has a 2 km trail groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) and lighted for night skiing. The Calgary Ski Club maintains trails at three golf courses around Calgary including 7 km of groomed trails at Shaganappi Golf Course.

properties.Name: Banff townsite
properties.Notes: Trails: Three trails on the south side of the town of Banff have a combined total of 33 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.Sundance trail (groomed rated Easy) runs 4 km along the Bow River then gently ascends to Sundance Canyon. It also connects to the Brewster Creek trail leading to Sundance Lodge.Spray River Loop (groomed rated Easy to Moderate) runs 12.5 km from Bow Falls along both sides of Spray River.The Goat Creek trail (groomed rated Moderate) continues from the far end of the Spray River Loop to a trailhead on Spray Lakes Road in Kananaskis Country. It's mainly uphill from Banff and a total distance of 19 km one way so its best to get dropped off on Spray Lake Road and ski to Banff if possible.There are also several backcountry trails including the Rundle Riverside trail extending 16 km to Canmore Nordic Centre.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanches check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Sundance Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Brewster Creek Trail is a 11 km linear trail that leads to the Sundance backcountry lodge. The groomed cross-country ski trail is rated Moderate. In addition there are about another 40 km of backcountry trails in the region.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanche check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Lake Minnewanka/Cascade
properties.Notes: Trails: A very popular trail in Banff National Park is the Cascade Trail at Lake Minnewanka which is a linear groomed trail (14 km each way). The trail is rated Easy and crosses the Cascade River near its midpoint.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanches check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Castle Junction
properties.Notes: Trails: Near Castle Junction in Banff National Park there are several trails suitable for cross-country skiing two of which are groomed: the Castle Junction and Red Earth Creek trails (both rated Moderate). Castle Junction trail is 9 km one way. Red Earth Creek trail is 12 km one way. Shadow Lake Lodge (open weekends Feb-Mar) is another 3 km past the end of the groomed trail. There are also several backcountry trails.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanche check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Baker Creek
properties.Notes: Trails: The Baker Creek region of Banff National Park has about 17 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are some backcountry trails.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanche check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Lake Louise
properties.Notes: Trails: In the Lake Louise region of Banff National Park more than 50 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are some backcountry trails. Trails link the lake and town of Lake Louise and extend north and south including one that goes 10 km to the Great Divide and Yoho National Park.On the east side of the highway the Pipestone network provides another 20 km of ski trails. Most of the groomed trails in the Lake Louise area are rated Novice Easy and Moderate. Approximately 20 km are groomed for both classic and skate.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanche check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Syncline
properties.Notes: Trails: Syncline Provincial Recreation Area offers 17 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing. Castle Mountain Resort located a few km south of Syncline also has a cross-country ski trail.

properties.Name: Athabasca Falls
