properties.Notes: Trails: On the Icefields Parkway in Jasper National Park 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing on unplowed roads making three linear trails: Whirlpool and Leach Lake both about 10 km and rated Easy/Moderate and Geraldinr Road 6 km Very Difficult.

properties.Name: Whistlers Campground
properties.Notes: Trails: South of the town of Jasper several trails are groomed for cross-country skiing:

properties.Name: Pyramid Lake Rd
properties.Notes: Trails: In Jasper National Park 17 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing at two locations near the town of Jasper:

properties.Name: Maligne Road
properties.Notes: Trails: On Maligne Road there are several trails that are suitable for cross-country skiing at two separate areas: Summit Lakes and Maligne Lake. Summit Lakes is a 4 km groomed linear trail that is rated Easy.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanche check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Blue Lake Adventure Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: William Switzer Provincial Park has about 15 km of trails that are occasionally groomed for cross-country skiing by snowmobile when conditions permit. The trails are near Blue Lake Centre an outdoor education centre and retreat formerly known as Blue Lake Adventure Lodge. It is separate from the Athabasca Lookout Centre in the south section of the park.

properties.Name: Athabathsca Lookout Nordic Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: The Athabasca Lookout Centre in William Switzer Provincial Park has 40 km of trails 28 km of which are groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) by the Hinton Nordic Club. A 1.5 km trail is lighted for night skiing.Note that there is no on-site source of drinking water so bring your own.

properties.Name: Pierre Grey's Lakes
properties.Notes: Trails: Pierre Grey's Lakes Provincial Park has 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Smoky River Nordic Ski Club volunteers. There are also 9 km of backcountry trails in the park. The club also grooms trails in Grand Cache at Marv Moore Campground and the golf course.

properties.Name: Hornbeck Cross-Country Ski Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: At Hornbeck Creek Provincial Recreation Area 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Muskeg Flyers Nordic Ski Club and the Alberta Forest Service.

properties.Name: Pembina River Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Pembina River Prov. Park has 5 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing along the Pembina River valley.

properties.Name: Terratima Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: Terratima Lodge has 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including 2 km lighted for night skiing. There are also some backcountry trails.

properties.Name: Bearberry Nordic Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Bearberry Nordic offers 25 km of trails that are groomed for skate and classic cross-country skiing techniques on a working ranch.

properties.Name: Pigeon Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Pigeon Lake Provincial Park has 10 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by a local club. There are also 8 km of trails at the nature conservancy near Rundle's Mission about 10 km north.

properties.Name: Jarvis Bay Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Jarvis Bay Provincial Park has 7 km of ungroomed trails available for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Wabamun Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Wabamun Lake Provincial Park has 7 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: St. Albert Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 18 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the St. Albert Nordic Ski Club. There are 2 km of trails lighted for night skiing on certain evenings.

properties.Name: Waterton Lakes National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Two designated cross-country ski trails are located along the Akamina Parkway: the Dipper Trail (6 km return) and the Cameron Trail (5 km return). There are also several backcountry ski touring trails where there may be a possible avalanche hazard.

properties.Name: Cooking Lake-Blackfoot Prov. Rec. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Cooking Lake-Blackfoot Provincial Recreation Area offers 65 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 32 km for skating. There are also 35 km of backcountry trails. Cooking Lake-Blackfoot PRA is the site of the annual Canadian Birkebeiner in February.Trails connect four staging areas: Waskehegan Blackfoot Islet and Central. Blackfoot trails are mainly groomed for skating technique. See the Edmonton Nordic Ski Guide for more description.

properties.Name: Elk Island National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Elk Island National Park has 100 km of trails at various locations throughout the park some of which are groomed for cross-country skiing.Family Ski Day is held on the third Saturday in February.

properties.Name: Miquelon Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Miquelon Lake Provincial Park has 18 km of trail that are available for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Vermilion Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Vermilion Provincial Park offers 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Vermilion Nordic Ski Club. The trails were the original training grounds of Olympic gold-medalist Beckie Scott and now host the Beckie Scott Loppet.

properties.Name: Whitney Lakes Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Whitney Lakes Provincial Park has 21 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing and 7 km of ungroomed trails.

properties.Name: Cypress Hills Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Cypress Hills Provincial Park has 14 km of trails they are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are also some backcountry trails. There are two separate trail systems each with about 7 km of trails: Spring Creek and Spruce Coulee. Spring Creek trails are rated Easy Spruce Coulee are intermediate to expert.

properties.Name: Cold Lake Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Cold Lake Provincial Park's 13 km of trail are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Moose Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: The park is no longer open in winter.

properties.Name: Shaw Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Lakeland Provincial Recreation Area offers 26 km of trail at Shaw Lake that are groomed for cross-country skiing. There are several loops including one trail of more than 20 km in length around the perimeter of Shaw Lake. The Shaw Lake trails are the site of the annual Lac La Loppet.

properties.Name: Long Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Long Lake Prov. Park has 12 km of ungroomed trails available for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Tawatinaw (Westlock Ski Club)
properties.Notes: Trails: Tawatinaw Valley has 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic). It is the host of the annual pre-Birkie event the Tawatinaw Valley Loppet in early February.

properties.Name: Thunder Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Thunder Lake Provincial Park has 12 km of trails available for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Carson-Pegasus Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Carson-Pegasus Provincial Park offers 6 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. There are also some ski trails in Whitecourt.

properties.Name: Sandhills
properties.Notes: Trails: The trails at Sandhills are no longer groomed for cross-country skiing. However there are some ski trails in Whitecourt.

properties.Name: Swan Hills Cross-Country Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Swan Hills 8 km of trails maybe available for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Grizzly Ridge
properties.Notes: Trails: 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Lesser Slave Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Lesser Slave Lake Prov. Park has 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing at two sites. A section of the Trans Canada Trail called the Frontier Trail runs through the park along the lakeshore.

properties.Name: Hilliard's Bay Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Cross-country skiing is no longer offered in the park.

properties.Name: Winagami Lake Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Winagami Lake Provincial Park offers 18 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Young's Point Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Young's Point Prov. Park 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: O'Brien Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: O'Brien Prov. Park offers 12 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Wapiti Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Wapiti Nordic Ski Club grooms 35 km of trails for cross-country skiing. A 4.5 km trail is lighted for night skiing. The centre was the site of the 1995 Canada Winter Games.

properties.Name: Saskatoon Island Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Saskatoon Island Prov. Park's 6 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Moonshine Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Moonshine Provincial Park's 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Queen Elizabeth Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Queen Elizabeth Provincial Park offers 5 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Smith-Dorrien
properties.Notes: Trails: About 32 km of trails are groomed intermittently for cross-country skiing in the Smith-Dorrien section of Kananaskis Country. Trails are rated mostly intermediate to expert.

properties.Name: Fort McMurray Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: In Fort McMurray the 20-km Birchwood Trail system is groomed by the Ptarmigan Nordic Ski Club. The trails were the site of the 2004 Artic Winter Games and they host the annual Ptarmigan Loppet. Gregoire Lake Provincial Park south of town has 10 km of ungroomed trails.

properties.Name: Peter Lougheed Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: 85 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiers of all levels of ability in the Peter Lougheed Provincial Park section of Kananaskis Country.

properties.Name: Kitimat XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: At Onion Lake the Snow Valley Nordic Ski Club grooms 25 km of trails by snowcat for cross-country skiing. They light 5 km of trails for night skiing and allow dogs on one of the trails. The club hosts the annual Snow Valley Marathon in February.

properties.Name: Cariboo Ski Touring Club
properties.Notes: Trails: The Cariboo Ski Touring Club grooms 10 km of trails for cross-country skiing at Ten Mile Lake plus another 20 km at Hallis Lake including a 2.5 km lighted loop. The club hosts the Hallis Lake Loppet in January.

properties.Name: Williams Lake XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: At Bull Mountain near Williams Lake 28 km of trails are groomed by snowcat for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) by the Williams Lake Cross Country Ski Club. Two loops totalling 3.5 km trail are lighted for night skiing.

properties.Name: 108 Resort (Best Western)
properties.Notes: Trails: At 108 Mile Ranch 56 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including a lighted loop for night skiing. The trails connect with the Hills Snow Park and are part of a 150-km community network.

properties.Name: Hills Health & Guest Ranch
properties.Notes: Trails: The Hills Snow Park offers 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the resort. A Snowcat groomer and snaowmaking equipment help ensure the best possible ski conditions. The Hills trails connect with the 108 Mile Ranch network and are part of a 150-km community network around 100 Mile House.

properties.Name: Red Coach Inn
properties.Notes: Trails: The Red Coach Inn offers 11 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing and is part of the 150-km community network around 100 Mile House. The trails connect with the 99 Mile Ski Trails

properties.Name: Clinton Snow Jockey Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Clinton Snow Jockey Club plus there are also 25 km of backcountry trails. The trails are above 1100 metres in elevation so there is usually more snow than at lower elevations.

properties.Name: Big Bar Guest Ranch
properties.Notes: Trails: Big Bar Guest Ranch offers ungroomed trails for Guests Only

properties.Name: Tyax Mountain Lake Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: At Tyax Mountain Lake Resort 17 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are also 20 km of backcountry trails.Note: This information may be out of date. There is no winter activities mentioned on the resort's website so it may no longer be open in winter.

properties.Name: Whistler Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: In the town of Whistler 32 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skate) in Lost Lake Park and on two golf courses. Four km of trails are lighted for night skiing. Many other areas nearby are suitable for backcountry touring and telemarking but check the avalanche conditions before setting out.Two other nearby ski areas are Callaghan Country and the Whistler Olympic Park site of the nordic ski events for the 2010 Olympic Winter Games.

properties.Name: Whistler Olympic Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Whistler Olympic Park the venue for the 2010 Olympic nordic competitions offers 55 km of groomed trails. The park's trails connect with those of Callaghan Country and together they offer a total of more than 90 km of groomed trails.The competition trails for cross-country skiing and biathlon together with additional recreational trails provide 11 beginner trails 12 intermediate and four expert trails. Six km of trails are lighted for night skiing one evening a week and there are 5 km of rollerski trails during the summer.The Whistler Olympic Park operates from mid-November to mid-April when snow conditions permit. Before planning your trip check the park's event calendar to see if the trails will be closed for an event. BC's largest loppet the P'ayakentsut is held here in February.

properties.Name: Cypress Bowl XC Ski Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Cypress Mountain offers 19 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) including a 7 km lighted trail for night skiing. Cypress was the site of the freestyle skiing and snowboarding competitions for the 2010 Olympic Winter Games.

properties.Name: Hemlock Valley Ski Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Hemlock Valley Ski Resort offers 7 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing plus another 6 km of backcountry trails.

properties.Name: McDowell Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: McDowell Lake Ski Trails 30 km groomed. Lots of single track some double track some skating lanes. Some difficult sections lots of intermediate sections and lots of easy sections.

properties.Name: Morice Mountain Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: About 45 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by Morice Mountain Nordic. Two km of trails are lighted for evening skiing.

properties.Name: Wells Gray Outdoor Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Candle Creek near Clearwater has 35 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including some skating trails. The trails are for skiers of all levels of abilities. There are also groomed trails in Wells Gray Provincial Park.

properties.Name: Helmcken Falls Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: In Wells Gray Provincial Park there are 45 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing by Murtle River Nordics and Helmcken Falls Lodge. Most of the trails are long loops. The Birchleg Loppet (16 and 30 km) takes place in mid-February between Majerus Farm and Helmcken Falls Lodge.There are also lots of backcountry trails connecting several huts in the park. Guided and self-sufficient hut-to-hut treks and telemarking trips are possible.CAUTION: In backcountry areas there may be a possibility of avalanches check the avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Jackman Flats
properties.Notes: Trails: At Jackman Flats Provincial Park 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Yellowhead Outdoor Rec. Association. Another 9 km of trails at Camp Creek are also groomed.

properties.Name: Sovereign Lake Ski Area
properties.Notes: Trails: More than 40 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing by the Sovereign Lake Nordic Club link up with the adjacent Silver Star trails for a combined total of more than 100 km. The trails are all groomed and trackset for both skating and classic techniques and consist of 7 km of Novice 7 km Intermediate and 27 km Advanced.A 4 km trail is lighted for night skiing on certain evenings. A volunteer ski patrol operates on weekends.The Sovereign Lake Nordic Centre hosted a Cross Country FIS World Cup in 2005 and the 2011 Masters World Cup. It is the site of early-season training camps in late November and of the annual Sovereign Lake Loppet in early March.

properties.Name: Apex Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Apex Resort grooms 12 km of trails for cross-country skiing around the alpine ski village including a 1 km lighted trail for night skiing.

properties.Name: Mt Baldy XC Area
properties.Notes: Trails: At Mt Baldy Nordic Centre 15 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. Another 20 km of ungroomed trails are shared with snowshoers.

properties.Name: Mount Revelstoke NP
properties.Notes: Trails: Mount Revelstoke National Park offers an 8 km trail that is groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are many backcountry trails. There are also 22 km of groomed trails nearby at Mount MacPherson.CAUTION: There's a possibility of avalanche in this area check the avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines. There is a voluntary register for backcountry trips at the Parks Canada office in Revelstoke 300 - 3rd Street West.

properties.Name: Glacier National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Backcountry skiing onlyCAUTION: There's a possibility of avalanche hazard in this area check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Yoho National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Within the Rockies' magnificent Yoho National Park six trails are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are also 150 km of backcountry trails. Popular areas are Natural Bridge/Emerald Lake Lake O'Hara and Takakkaw Falls. A 4 km ungroomed trail connects Lake O'Hara to the Great Divide and continues 12 km to Lake Louise.CAUTION: There's a possibility of avalanche at certain points in this area check the avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Whitetooth Ski Center
properties.Notes: Trails: At Kicking Horse Mountain Resort the Golden Nordic Ski Club grooms the 24 km Dawn Mountain Nordic trailsystem. About 15 km are groomed for skating technique.

properties.Name: Kootenay National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Backcountry skiing onlyCAUTION: In this area there's a possibility of avalanche check the park's avalanche bulletin before heading out and follow the proper avalanche safety guidelines.

properties.Name: Beckie Scott Nordic Centre/Panorama Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: At Panorama mountain resort 28 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing for both skating and classic technique. The Beckie Scott Nordic Centre is named after the Olympic gold-winning skier and is home to the Toby Creek Nordic Ski Club. The annual Toby Creek Nordic Panorama Skate Loppet is held in early February.

properties.Name: Fairmont Hot Springs Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Fairmont Hot Springs Resort offers several km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing on a golf course and at the downhill ski resort.

There are also about 15 km of backcountry trails.Remarks by the club president (2004): Most of the trails are marked but we are still improving them so expect the unexpected. A wolf fox wolverine or some two legged creature may have knock over a sign but look for the ski tracks.We live and play in an isolated remote northern Canadian wilderness region (Latitude 65 degrees) where common sense must prevail. Limited sun light cold weather and sudden changes in weather are extreme hazards. When you travel the ski trails connecting multi-use trails and back country make sure to let someone know where exactly you are headed and your expected time of return. There are no patrols of the ski trails multi-use trails or back country so if you get yourself into trouble you are on your own!

properties.Notes: Trails: At Foley Mountain Conservation Area 4 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Mount Pakenham
properties.Notes: Trails: At Mount Pakenham 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing plus there are some backcountry trails.

properties.Name: G. MacCormack Maitland Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Gordon MacCormack Maitland Trails has about 15 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Upper Canada Bird Sanctuary
properties.Notes: Trails: At Upper Canada Bird Sanctuary there are about 8 km of mainly easy trails groomed for cross-country skiing. The Friends of the Sanctuary a volunteer group running the winter program operate the Interpretive Centre from early January to late March. Moonlight ski tours are offered each month weather and trail conditions permitting.

properties.Name: Larose Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: In the Larose County Forest there are 18 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing mainly easy singletrack with some intermediate sections.

properties.Name: Voyageur (Carillon) Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing in Voyageur Provincial Park (formerly known as Carillon Provincial Park).

properties.Name: Pukaskwa National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Pukaskwa National Park offer 5 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Hearst XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Hearst has 40 km of trails groomed for classic and skating cross-country skiing. There are 14 trails ranging in length from 1 to 3 km. Full-moon ski tours are organized each month as well as a loppet in March.

properties.Name: Windy Lake Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: 50 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing for guests only. The resort is only accessible by train.

properties.Name: Chadwick's Kwagama Lake Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: Kwagama Lake Lodge no longer offer winter trips and cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Mt. Evergreen
properties.Notes: Trails: Mt. Evergreen offers 20 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing. Some trails are groomed for both skate and classic technique. About 3 km of trails are lighted for night skiing on certain evenings. Mount Evergreen in conjunction with Kenora Nordic Trails Association received a grant from the Trillium Foundation in 2005 for the upgrade of its facilities.There are also 5 km of trails in Kenora at Vernon Nature Trails.

properties.Name: Searchmont Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Searchmont Resort has 4 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic).

properties.Name: Wakomata Shores Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Some ungroomed trails are available for cross-country skiing and are for guests only.

properties.Name: Iron Bridge Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: At Iron Bridge 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only).Note: This info is out of date so it is not known if the trails are still in operation. Please send us an update if you have recent info.

properties.Name: Killarney Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Killarney Provincial Park two trails totalling 18 km are groomed for cross-country skiing including 7 km for skating. One is rated Intermediate the other Easy. There is also an ungroomed backcountry trail 14 km in length that is more challenging. Friends of Killarney organize a Nordic Club and an annual Winter Activity Day.

properties.Name: Elliot Lake Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Near the city of Elliot Lake about 16 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing at Spine Road. The five stacked loops extend along the south shore of Elliott Lake. There are also ungroomed trails located at several spots around town:

properties.Name: Walden Cross Country Fitness Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Walden Cross Country Fitness Club grooms 30 km of trails for cross-country skiing at two separate areas: Naughton and Beaver Lake. The Naughton trails consist of 12 interconnected loops mostly classic double track and varying from easy to difficult. There is also 4 km of skating trails and a 3 km lighted trail for night skiing. Beaver Lake offers 5 km of classic trails in three stacked loops.

properties.Name: Lake Laurentian Conservation Area
properties.Notes: Trails: The BioSki Cross-Country Ski & Snowshoe Club grooms 15 km of trails for cross-country skiing in Lake Laurentian Conservation Area. The trails connect to the Laurentian Nordic Ski Trails to the west.

properties.Name: Kukagami Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: Kukagami Lodge backcountry lodge offers 28 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (singletrack classic). The trails have lots of difficult and intermediate sections and some easy sections.

properties.Name: Loney's Sportsman Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: Lodge appears to cater to snowmobilers and do not provide cross-country ski information.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Rushing River Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Rushing River Provincial Park grooms 16 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 10 for skating technique.

properties.Name: Windy Lake Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Windy Lake Provincial Park about 15 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Onaping Falls Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Capreol XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 23 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only) by the Capreol Cross-Country Ski Club. Moonlight ski tours are held each month followed by pizza and entertainment.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Kettle Lakes Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Kettle Lakes Provincial Park 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Iroquois Falls XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Iroquois Falls Cross-Country Ski Club grooms 25 km of trails for cross-country skiing. The club organizes moonlight ski tours each month.

properties.Name: Temiskaming Nordic Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Temiskaming Nordic Ski Club grooms 20 km of trails for cross-country skiing (skate and classic).

properties.Name: Smoothwater Outfitters
properties.Notes: Trails: Smoothwater of Temagami offers 50 km of trails that are packed (but not track-set) for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Temagami Wilderness Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Backcountry trails are available for cross-country skiing at several locations throughout the Temagami region.

properties.Name: Temagami Shores Inn & Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: According to one report Temagami Shores Inn grooms trails in Finlayson Point Provincial Park but there is no info about cross-country skiing on the resort's website (it appears to cater to snowmobilers).

properties.Name: West Nipissing Nordic Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: About 10 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the West Nipissing Nordic Ski Club. The trails are single track with lots of easy sections some intermediate sections and some difficult sections.

properties.Name: Nordic Nomad Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Sioux Lookout has about 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Nordic Nomad Ski Club.

properties.Name: Samuel de Champlain Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Samuel de Champlain Provincial Park 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Mattawa Golf & Ski Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Mattawa Golf & Ski Resort offers 20 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Wasi Cross-Country Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Wasi Cross-Country Ski Club grooms 20 km of singletrack trails for cross-country skiing in stacked loops of 2 4 8 11 and 15 km. There are some difficult sections and lots of intermediate and easy sections.

properties.Name: South River Community Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At South River Community Trails 10 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: The Caswell Resort Hotel
properties.Notes: Trails: About 12 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing are 5 minutes from the Caswell Resort Hotel.

properties.Name: Point Pelee National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Point Pelee National Park 5 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing when conditions permit.

properties.Name: Backus Woods
properties.Notes: Trails: Backus Woods Conservation Area offers 12 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing through Carolinian woods and a marsh.

properties.Name: Pinery Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Pinery Provincial Park offers 38 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiers of all levels of ability. About 11 km are groomed for skating technique.

properties.Name: Stoney Island Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: About 8 km of trails at Stoney Island Conservation Area are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Kincardine Cross Country Ski Club. Another 10 km of fairly flat trails are located south of Kincardine.

properties.Name: Northern Comfort Wilderness Adv.
properties.Notes: Trails: 40 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Sauble Beach XC Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Sauble Beach Cross Country Ski Club grooms 18 km of trails for cross-country skiing near Sauble Falls Provincial Park.Another 11 km of trails at MacGregor Point Provincial Park are groomed by the park.

properties.Name: Wiarton area Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Three trail systems are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Bruce Ski Club:

properties.Name: Bruce Peninsula NP
properties.Notes: Trails: Bruce Peninsula National Park offers a few km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Inglis Falls Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Inglis Falls Conservation Area offers 8 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Glenelg Nordic
properties.Notes: Trails: Glenelg Nordic Ski Club grooms about 25 km of trails in Grey County Forest. Only about half the trails (those on the south side of Concession Rd 8) are open to non-members. The trails north of the Concession Rd 8 are for members of GNSC only.

properties.Name: Minto Glen Sports Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: CLOSED for cross-country skiing due to insurance issues.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Allan Park Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Allan Park Conservation Area offers 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Cambridge Area Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Shade's Mills Conservation Area offers 14 km of groomed trails for cross-country skiing.Pinehurst Lake Conservation Area no longer grooms trails for cross-country skiing but the 12 km of trails can be used for skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Laurel Creek Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Laurel Creek Conservation Area has 8 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Valens Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Valens Conservation Area offers 10 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Hilton Falls Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: At Hilton Falls Conservation Area 16 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Atikokan/Quetico Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 45 km of trails in the town of Atikokan are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Beaten Path Nordic Ski Club. In addition they also groom another 25 km in Quetico Provincial Park. The club hosts the Sawmill Lake Classic in January the Chocolate Cup Challenge in February and the annual Cross Quetico Lakes Tour (35-55 km).

properties.Name: Mountsberg Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Mountsberg Conservation Area offers 16 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Seneca College
properties.Notes: Trails: Seneca College has 14 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing when conditions permit. The trails are open only on weekends.

properties.Name: Albion Hills Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: At Albion Hills Conservation Area 26 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing in the Caledon Hills and along the banks of the Humber River. One trail is groomed for skating technique.

properties.Name: Palgrave Forest Wildlife Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Palgrave Forest and Wildlife Area is not maintained for cross-country skiing but it is still possible to ski on the area's 17 km of trails. It is a popular destination on the Oak Ridges Moraine for outdoor recreation and a new trail system is planned.

properties.Name: Mansfield Outdoor Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Mansfield Outdoor Centre offers 40 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 10 km for skating technique. Trails vary in difficulty from easy to expert.

properties.Name: Wasaga Beach Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: The Wasaga Nordic Centre (formerly Blueberry Trails) offers 30 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only) through pine-oak forest and over sand dunes.There are 7 km of easy 8 km of moderate and 10 km of difficult trails.

properties.Name: Horseshoe Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Horseshoe Resort offers 35 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing some with skating lanes. Several times each season the trails are lit by lanterns.

properties.Name: Springwater Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Springwater Provincial Park has 13 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Kakabeka Falls Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: 13 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing at Kakabeka Falls Provincial Park by the Thunder Bay Nordic Trails Association.

properties.Name: Hardwood Hills
properties.Notes: Trails: Hardwood Hills is Ontario's premier centre for ski racing enthusiasts. Its 30 km of trails are groomed for both classic and skating cross-country ski techniques. Some trails are lighted for night skiing several evenings each week. About 5 km of trails have snowmaking capabilities. There are also some backcountry trails for snowshoeing and skiing.

properties.Name: Lafontaine Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Note: Unfortunately this centre is no longer in operation.

properties.Name: Awenda Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Awenda Provincial Park's 17 km of trails are no longer groomed for cross-country skiing but they can used for backcountry skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Wye Marsh Wildlife Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Wye Marsh Wildlife Centre offers 22 km of nature trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. Another 10 km of trails are available for snowshoeing. Moonlight ski tours are held each month throughout the winter.

properties.Name: Bayview-Wildwood Resorts
properties.Notes: Trails: At Bayview-Wildwood Resort several trails are available for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: The Briars Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: The Briars Resort grooms 8 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Sibbald Point Prov. Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Sibbald Point Provincial Park offers 8 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Pleasure Valley
properties.Notes: Trails: Trails are no longer groomed for cross-country skiing at this alpine ski resort.Note: According to the latest report this facility no longer offers cross-country skiing (see Ratings below). Apparently the lack of snow in recent years made regular operation too difficult. If you have information to the contrary please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Dagmar Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Dagmar Resort offers 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Heber Down Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Heber Down Conservation Area has 10 km of trails that are available for cross-country skiing but are also used for walking dogs.

properties.Name: Long Sault Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: At Long Sault Conservation Area 18 km of ungroomed trails are available for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Trillium Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Cross-country skiing has not been offered since 2001. Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Ken Reid Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Ken Reid Conservation Area has 8 km of ungroomed trails that are available for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Ganaraska Forest Centre
properties.Notes: Trails: Ganaraska Forest Centre offers 35 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Warsaw Caves Cons. Area
properties.Notes: Trails: Warsaw Caves Conservation Area has 13 km of ungroomed trails available for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Viamede Resort
properties.Notes: Trails: Viamede Resort & Conference Centre has several km of trails for snowshoeing and cross-country skiing but the trails are not groomed.

properties.Name: Gravenhurst KOA Nordic Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At Gravenhurst KOA 15 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. The trails are mainly single-track classic.

properties.Name: Sherwood Inn
properties.Notes: Trails: The Delta Sherwood Inn has private trails for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Shamrock Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: At Shamrock Lodge there are 13 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Georgian Bay Ski & Canoe Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Georgian Nordic grooms 25 km of trails for cross-country skiing (skate and classic). There are some difficult sections some intermediate and lots of easy sections of trails. Georgian Nordic hosts the annual Sounder Ski Tour and Special Olympics in early February.

properties.Name: Minett Landing Nordic Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: At Minett Landing 16 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing for classic and skating by Hatchets Outdoor Centre. Three km are rated Easy the remainder are Moderate.

properties.Name: Hill & Gully Riders Snowmobile Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 20 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Cedar Grove Lodge
properties.Notes: Trails: There are about 10 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing at Cedar Grove Lodge.

properties.Name: Blue Water Acres
properties.Notes: Trails: At Blue Water Acres 12 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the resort.

properties.Name: Arrowhead Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Arrowhead Provincial Park has 27 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing The trails range from easy to difficult and include 10 km of skating lanes. The park is the site of the annual Muskoka Loppet hosted by the Arrowhead Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Deerhurst Resort Trail System
properties.Notes: Trails: At Deerhurst Resort 13 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing for guests only.

properties.Name: Grandview Inn
properties.Notes: Trails: Grandview Inn has 15 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing (whether they are groomed or not is not known).

properties.Name: Brookvale Provincial Ski Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Brookvale Provincial Ski Park offers 25 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 7 km of competition trails. Some trails are groomed for skating. Two kilometres of trails are lighted for night skiing one evening a week. Moonlight ski tours and a loppet are organized each year by the Brookvale Cross Country Ski Club. Centre is open Wednesday to Sunday.

properties.Name: Prince Edward Island National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: PEI National Park has 10 km of trails available for cross-country skiing on the Woodlands and Bubbling Springs trails near Dalvay and another 8 km trail is near Stanhope.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Nordic
properties.Notes: Trails: Matagami's Club de ski de fond Nordic reportedly grooms 20 km of trails for cross-country skiing.Note that this information is out of date and no recent info is available. If you have up-to-date info on this destination please contact us.

properties.Name: Edielweiss Ski Center
properties.Notes: Trails: Edelweiss Ski Center no longer offers cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Base Militaire de Valcartier
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre Plein Air Castor has 27 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skate technique) on the Valcartier Military base. The biathlon course was the training ground for 1994 Olympic gold medalist Myriam Bedard.

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond de Val-Belair
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de ski de fond de Val-Belair maintains 27 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Le Refuge
properties.Notes: Trails: 46 km* of trails are groomed for cross-country skiings including 9 km for skating. The trails are linked with those of Sentiers de Moulin a return trip of about 50 km between trailheads.*Length with no overlap. The length of trails is sometimes given as more than 100 km but that figure was calculated by including overlapping sections of trail more than once.

properties.Name: Club Mont-Torbillon
properties.Notes: Trails: Mont-Torbillon appears to no longer groom their trails for cross-country skiing but there are 12 km of snowshoeing trails.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont-Sainte-Anne
properties.Notes: Trails: Mont-Sainte-Anne is Quebec's largest cross-country ski resort with approximately 105 km* of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 60 km of skating trails. A 65-km backcountry trail connects with Camp Mercier.*Length with no overlap. The length is sometimes given as 210 km but that figure was calculated by including overlapping sections of trail more than once.

properties.Name: Sentiers des Caps de Charlevoix
properties.Notes: Trails: Sentier des Caps de Charlevoix offers 32 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing. The centre is at an elevation of 800 metres so enjoys a long ski season. There is also a 50-km linear backcountry trail overlooking the St Lawrence River connecting several huts. Baggage transport and car transfer services are available.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Ferme-Neuve
properties.Notes: Trails: Montagne du Diable near Ferme-Neuve offers about 70 km of trails for cross-country skiing of which 30 km are groomed for classic and skating. Most of the trails are rated Intermediate and Difficult.

properties.Name: Le Genevrier
properties.Notes: Trails: Le Genevrier outdoor centre offers 12 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Mont Grand-Fonds
properties.Notes: Trails: Mont Grand-Fonds has about 69 km* of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including about 15 km for skating technique. Snowfall averages about 650 cm (over 20 feet) per year so the ski season is long.*Length with no overlap. The length is often publicized as more than 100 km but that figure was calculated by including overlapping sections of trail more than once.

properties.Name: Parc des Grands-Jardins
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc des Grands-Jardins has 40 km of snow-covered roads that are available for backcountry skiing and snowshoeing including a section of the Traversee de Charlevoix.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air Bec-Scie
properties.Notes: Trails: Bec-Scie outdoor centre has more than 20 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including some for skating.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Le Norvegien
properties.Notes: Trails: The Club de ski de fond Le Norvegien grooms 40 km of trails for cross-country skiing including some for skating technique. A 4-km trail is lighted for night skiing on certain evenings.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond d'Alma
properties.Notes: Trails: Club de ski de fond le Dorval d'Alma grooms about 24 km of trails for cross-country skiing (classic and skating). Three trails are lighted for night skiing on weekday nights.

properties.Name: Club Tobo-Ski
properties.Notes: Trails: Club Tobo-Ski grooms 36 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Chibougamau
properties.Notes: Trails: At Chibougamau's Parc Obalski 25 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing. There are 5 km of easy trails 15 km of intermediate and 5 km of expert trails.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air St-Nazaire
properties.Notes: Trails: Base de plein air St-Nazaire reportedly has 28 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond de Mt Valin
properties.Notes: Trails: At Parc des Monts-Valin 20 km of trails are groomed for classic and skating. There are another 50 km backcountry trails including one to the Vallee des Fantomes (heavily-snowed trees that look like ghosts) with a snowcat shuttle service available. Hut-to-hut trips are possible. This region usually has one of the longest ski seasons in Quebec. Groomed trails are open Friday to Sunday.

properties.Name: Parc du Saguenay
properties.Notes: Trails: The Saguenay provincial park offers 30 km of challenging backcountry ski trails in Les Caps sector. Les Murailles sector consisting of Lac Emmuraille Mont Edouard Lac Tout-Nu and Lac Cardinal have 100 km of ungroomed ski trails and are operated by a local organization.Note: La Montagne Blanche Sector is prone to avalanches and is extremely dangerous so access is prohibited in winter.

properties.Name: Sentier de la riviere Amedee
properties.Notes: Trails: At Sentier de la riviere Amedee 32 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by a local ski club. The trails consist of lots of easy and intermediate sections and a few difficult sections. Most of the trails are single-track classic but several are groomed for skating. On weekends the trails are patrolled by volunteers.

properties.Name: Sentier Nor-Fond
properties.Notes: Trails: About 33 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Club de Ski Norfond. A 4-km trail is lighted for night skiing.

properties.Name: Base de plein air Les Goelands
properties.Notes: Trails: Les Goelands outdoor centre has 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 7 km for skating technique.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Rapido de Sept-Iles
properties.Notes: Trails: The Club de ski de fond Rapido grooms 35 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 13 km for both skating and classic. There are 12 trails two of which are rated expert and three rated intermediate.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Anik
properties.Notes: Trails: Club de ski de fond Anik grooms 22 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Pohenegamook Sante Plein Air
properties.Notes: Trails:Pohenegamook Sante Plein Air health resort claims 45 km* of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.*Note that the total length of the trails may have been calculated by including overlapping sections of trail more than once. With no overlap the total is probably less than half the stated amount.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont-Comi
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc du Mont-Comi ski resort has 20 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing skate and classic.

properties.Name: Val-Neigette
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing at the Ski de fond Mouski cooperative including about 20 km for skating technique. The club hosts the annual Skiathlon Mouski in early March. Another 10 km of trails (skating and classic) are nearby at the Val-Neigette ski resort.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air de Saint-Damase
properties.Notes: Trails: The Base de plein air de Saint Damase seems to no longer have trails groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Station de ski Val d'Irene
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc regional Val d'Irene has 15 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Base de Plein-Air des Outaouais
properties.Notes: Trails: Base de Plein-Air des Outaouais reportedly has 41 km of trails that may be groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Parc de la Gaspesie
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc de la Gaspesie offers 24 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only). There are also 180 km of backcountry ski trails through the famous Chic-Choc mountains connecting several backcountry huts. The terrain is mostly alpine tundra and taiga.Caution: In some sections of the park there may be a possibility of avalanches. Check with the park administrators before hitting the slopes.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air de Saint-Simeon
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de plein air de Saint-Simeon has 18 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. There are also 12 km of groomed trails at Centre de Plein-Air Tourbillon near Bonaventure.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Base de plein air de Bellefeuille
properties.Notes: Trails: Base de plein air de Bellefeuille has 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Parc National Forillon
properties.Notes: Trails: Forillon National Park offers 40 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. The five trails range in length from 7 km to 16 km. The groomed trails are in the interior of the park on unplowed roads. There are also some ungroomed trails near the shoreline.

properties.Name: Centre de ski Mont Sainte-Marie
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de ski Mont Sainte-Marie reportedly offers 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available on the resort's website. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Reserve faunique de Papineau-Labelle
properties.Notes: Trails: More than 100 km of ungroomed trails are available for hut-to-hut backcountry skiing in Reserve Faunique de Papineau-Labelle.

properties.Name: Chateau Montebello
properties.Notes: Trails: At Chateau Montebello there are 27 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing on the grounds of the luxurious resort. A 15 km trail extends north into the Kenauk Reserve In February the Chateau is the focal point of the Canadian Ski Marathon a two-day 160 km ski tour from Lachute to Buckingham.

properties.Name: Montevilla/Montebello
properties.Notes: Trails: It seems that the Montevilla Resort is sold for real estate and the municipal trails have been eliminated. Trails are nearby at Chateau Montebello.

properties.Name: Hotel mon Chez-Nous
properties.Notes: Trails: Four trails totalling 21 km were once available for cross-country skiing at Lac des Plages. The hotel is closed so it is uncertain whether the trails are still in operation. However there are reportedly trails nearby at Cheneville and Lac Simon (10 to 20 km each) and also at Centre Touristique de la Petite Rouge.

properties.Name: Parc d'Aiguebelle
properties.Notes: Trails: A 35 km network of backcountry ski and snowshoe trails throughout the Aiguebelle Provincial Park link nine huts that can be rented for overnight stays.

properties.Name: Huberdeau Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: In the Huberdeau region 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing mostly single track some double track and skating lanes. There are trails for all ranges of abilities. A ski trail is also located nearby at Arundel.

properties.Name: Saint-Jovite
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 45 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (including some with skating lanes) wend their way around the Mont-Tremblant resort and south towards the town of Saint-Jovite. Several backcountry trails traverse the region.Trails at Domaine St Bernard are situated in a more natural setting than the other trails through the town and resort. Roughly half the trails are rated Easy 40% Difficult and 10% Most Difficult.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont Tremblant
properties.Notes: Trails: In the western sector of Parc du Mont Tremblant (La Diable) near Lac Monroe 55 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including 13 km for skating technique. There are also a network of backcountry trails that connect with Pimbina in the eastern sector of the park. Backcountry huts are available for rent from the park.Six trails are rated Easy two Intermediate and three Difficult. New in 2012: a 13 km loop connects to the Chutes-Croches waterfall.

properties.Name: Base de plein air Le Petit Bonheur
properties.Notes: Trails: At Le P'tit Bonheur outdoor recreation centre 45 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. The trails are open to the public on weekends only.

properties.Name: Parc des campeurs
properties.Notes: Trails: At Parc des campeurs 45 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only). A trail connects with Saint-Adolphe 15 km to the south.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont-Tremblant
properties.Notes: Trails: The east sector of Parc du Mont-Tremblant (La Pimbina) offers about 50 km of ungroomed trails for cross-country skiing. The park's backcountry trails connect with La Diable (#24) in the western sector of the park to offer a total of more than 100 km of ski touring. Several backcountry huts are available for rent from the park.

properties.Name: La Reserve/Saint-Donat
properties.Notes: Trails: About 32 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing in St-Donat and at La Reserve resort. The trails are maintained by La Reserve resort and the Club plein air de Saint-Donat. A backcountry trail connects with l'Interval.

properties.Name: Forat Ouareau
properties.Notes: Trails: Foret Ouareau offers 29 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. Another 26 km of backcountry skiing on the Sentier National (National Trail) traversing several peaks is best suited to snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond d'Evian
properties.Notes: Trails: About 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Club de ski de fond d'Evain. A new chalet was opened in 2007. Six trails are rated Easy four Difficult and three Very Difficult.

properties.Name: Base de plein air l'Interval
properties.Notes: Trails: L'Interval outdoor centre offers 30 km of backcountry trails including a trail up Mt Kaikop one of the highest peaks in the region. A 10 km trail is groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Centre de Ski de Fond Val-David
properties.Notes: Trails: Val-David and Far Hills have a combined total of 63 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 12 km for skating. The trails connect with the P'tit Train du Nord linear park. There are also several backcountry trails one of which was blazed by the legendary Jackrabbit Johannsen.In 2005 a land dispute involving trails in the Val-David and Val-Morin region resulted in the creation of the 500-hectare Parc Dufresne encompassing many of the Far Hills and Val-David trails.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air Sainte-Adele
properties.Notes: Trails: At Sainte-Adele more than 40 km of of trails are available for cross-country skiing in two different locations: Mont-Rolland to the south and Loup Garou to the north near Chantecler. Most of the south trails are rated Very Difficult. Five groomed trails in the north sector provide 20 km of Intermdiate skiing.

properties.Name: St-Adolphe-d'Howard
properties.Notes: Trails: At St-Adolphe-d'Howard 30 km of trails are groomed for classic technique. Another 50 km of backcountry trails are located around the town. A trail connects with Parc des Campeurs 15 km to the north. An ungroomed trail links with the Morin Heights backcountry trails. Most of the trails are rated intermediate to advanced.

properties.Name: Viking Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Viking Ski Club grooms 50 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 10 km of racing trails with a lane for skating. Two sections of the trail are rated Easy two are Difficult and one is Most Difficult but most trails have both hilly and flat sections. The Viking trail system connects with those of Morin Heights. The club hosts the Morin-Heights Viking Loppet in late February.

properties.Name: Morin Heights
properties.Notes: Trails: The cross-country ski centre operated by the municipality of Morin-Heights offers 60 km of groomed trails plus there is also many backcountry trails. Two trails are rated Easy ten are Difficult and ten Most Difficult. Except for the Aerobic Corridor the trails are single-track with a recommended direction of travel.The groomed Norin Heights trails connect with those of the Viking Club. Backcountry trails connect with Saint-Adolphe 10 km north.

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond La Randonnee
properties.Notes: Trails: Brownsburg's Centre de ski de fond La Randonnee groom 24 km of trails for cross-country skiing (classic only) all rated Intermediate. The centre is open Wednesday to Sunday.

properties.Name: Lac Carling
properties.Notes: Trails: About 20 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing at the five-star Lac Carling resort.

properties.Name: Club de Montagne d'Argenteuil
properties.Notes: Trails: Closed in 1999--no longer operates

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond Gai-Luron
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de ski de fond Gai Luron grooms 24 km of trails for cross-country skiing (classic technique). Four km of trails are rated Beginner 8 km are Intermediate and 12 km are Expert.

properties.Name: Parc lineaire le P'tit Train du Nord
properties.Notes: Trails: The 45 km section of the P'tit Train du Nord rail trail from Saint-Jerome to Val-David is groomed for cross-country skiing (classic and skating technique). North of Val-David the trail is for snowmobiling only. The linear park links up with trails at the Riviere-du-Nord regional park Sainte-Adele and Val-David/Far-Hills. The trail rises gradually from St-Jerome to Val-David. Due to its even surface the trail does not require much snow to be skiable so has generally a longer ski season than the other nearby centres.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond de Granada
properties.Notes: Trails: About 16 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Granada ski club. Trails range from easy to intermediate.

properties.Name: Parc regional de la Riviere-du-Nord
properties.Notes: Trails: At the Parc regional de la Riviere-du-Nord there are 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 5 km for skating technique. Most of the trails are rated Easy or Intermediate. The trails connect with the P'tit Train du Nord linear park.

properties.Name: Parc d'Oka
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc d'Oka grooms 47 km of trails for cross-country skiing including 23 km for skating technique. Trails consist of easy lakeside loops and more challenging hillside trails. Twenty-seven km of trails are rated Easy 7 km are More Difficult and 16 km Most Difficult.A viewpoint at the top of the Calvaire hill overlooks Lac des Deux Montagnes. Seven stucco structures situated at the viewpoint and along the Calvaire trail house religious frescoes. A 4 km trail is lighted for night skiing on certain evenings.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air des Cedres
properties.Notes: Trails: The Base de plein air des Cadres offers 12 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic). Night skiing is offered twice a week.

properties.Name: L'Escapade Linear Park
properties.Notes: Trails: L'Escapde Linear Park in Rigaud has 25 km of cross-country ski trails through predominantly maple forest groomed by the city of Rigaud. The trails consist of three long loops with a few linear offshoots. Situated on Mont Rigaud half the trails are rated Difficult. From the upper trails there a viewpoints overlooking the St Lawrence valley and the Adirondacks.

properties.Name: Parc du Cap St Jacques
properties.Notes: Trails: Cap St Jacques Nature Park offers 15 km of easy trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the city of Montreal.

properties.Name: Parc regional du Bois-d'Ile-Bizard
properties.Notes: Trails: The Bois-d'Ile-Bizard Nature Park offers 18 km of mostly flat trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont-Royal
properties.Notes: Trails: Montreal's Mount Royal Park offers about 18 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing in the heart of the city. Trails are groomed for classic except for two separate skating trails, one at Beaver Lake and the other near Avenue Parc.The two loop trails around the summit of the mountain are one-way (clockwise) so make sure that you are going in the right direction. The summit trails are the most challenging on the island best suited to intermediate skiers. Other Montreal city parks that have easy ski trails include Maisonneuve and Angrignon parks with about 10 km each.

properties.Name: Parc regional de Saint-Bernard
properties.Notes: Trails: Saint-Bernard regional park has 18 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing. The trail network consists of 9 short trails most of which are rated easy.

properties.Name: Parc du Mont Saint-Bruno
properties.Notes: Trails: Mont Saint-Bruno provincial park grooms 35 km of trails for cross-country skiing of which 8 km include a skating lane. Three trails are rated Easy four are Difficult and one is Very Difficult. The trails are open several evenings a week for night skiing with a headlamp.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Nordic
properties.Notes: Trails: Club de ski de fond Nordic grooms more than 20 km of trails for cross-country skiing mainly for classic technique with some skating trails. The trails are located on a Canadian Armed Forces firing range a few km east of Mont Saint-Bruno

properties.Name: Les Pied Fartes
properties.Notes: Trails: At Camp Dudemaine about 22 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by Les Pieds Fartes (Waxed Feet) ski club. Two trails are rated easy five are difficult and three are very difficult.

properties.Name: Mont-Saint-Hilaire
properties.Notes: Trails: There are about 12 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing in the Mont-Saint-Hilaire nature reserve managed by McGill University. It has been designated as a UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve site for its unique environment.

properties.Name: Les sentiers de la Presqu'ile
properties.Notes: Trails: Les Sentiers de la Presqu'ile offers 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. Eight loop trails start from the bottom of a hillside and go up the hill.

properties.Name: Les Sentiers de la Cabane
properties.Notes: Trails: Les Sentiers de la Cabane offers 31 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: L'Envolee centre recreotouristique
properties.Notes: Trails: L'Envolee centre recreotouristique offers about 30 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including some for skating technique.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air Saint-Jean-de-Matha
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de plein air Saint-Jean-de-Matha has 66 km* of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. Seven trails range in length from 3 km to 20 km. One is rated Beginner two are Intermediate and three are Expert.*Note that the total length of trails in Quebec is often calculated by including overlapping sections of trail more than once. With no overlap the total is probably about half the stated amount.

properties.Name: Reserve faunique de Mastigouche
properties.Notes: Trails: The Catherine sector of the Reserve faunique Mastigouche formerly had 43 km of trails but now does not offer cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Reserve faunique de Mastigouche
properties.Notes: Trails: Trails are closed in winter.

properties.Name: Club 2 Temps
properties.Notes: Trails: 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Parc national de la Mauricie
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc national de la Mauricie offers 80 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. Seven trails are rated Easy five are Difficult and one is Very Difficult. Several warming huts are located every 5 km or so along the trails.The Defi Nordique a two-day event held in early March features classic and freestyle cross-country races a snowshoe geocaching loppet and a triple nordic team challenge.

properties.Name: Club de golf de Grand-Mere
properties.Notes: Trails: Club de golf de Grand-Mere no longer offers cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Station de ski Vallee du Parc
properties.Notes: Trails: Station de ski Vallee du Parc has 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Station de ski Val-Mauricie
properties.Notes: Trails: 15 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Club de golf Ki-8-Eb
properties.Notes: Trails: 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond Saint-Francois
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Club de ski de fond Saint-Francois including 7 km for classic. Trails are along the St-Francois River and through a campground and forest. Eight trails are rated Easy and two are Intermediate.

properties.Name: Domaine de Lac Louise
properties.Notes: Trails: Domaine de Lac Louise grooms 18 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond Richmond-Melbourne
properties.Notes: Trails: The Centre de ski de fond Richmond-Melbourne cancelled operations for the winter 2011-12 due to property access problems. Check back next year to see if service has resumed. When in operation there were about 40 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Centre de Plein Air Davignon
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de plein air is closed permanently but the trails may still be available for snowshoeing and backcountry skiing. The land is now protected as Domaine Naturel de Lac Gale.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond de Val d'Or
properties.Notes: Trails: Approximately 40 km of trails are snowcat groomed for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) by the Val d'Or ski club including 3.5 km of lighted trails for night skiing.

properties.Name: Station de ski Bromont
properties.Notes: Trails: Bromont resort has 50 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing but they are no longer groomed.

properties.Name: Au Diable Vert
properties.Notes: Trails: Au Diable Vert's 12 km of backcountry trails link with Sentiers de l'Estrie and Parc d'environnement naturel de Sutton.

properties.Name: Plein Air Mont Echo (Farmer's Rest)
properties.Notes: Trails: As of 2002 the centre is out of business. There were about 50 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.If you know of any changes to the status of this centre please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Skiwippi
properties.Notes: Trails: The trail has been closed because some landowners refuse to permit right of way.

properties.Name: Parc de la Gorge de Coaticook
properties.Notes: Trails: Parc de la Gorge de Coaticook no longer grooms trails for cross-country skiing. The 15 km of trails are now only used for snowshoeing.

properties.Name: Club de ski de fond de l'Or Blanc
properties.Notes: Trails: The Club de ski de fond de l'Or Blanc grooms 28 km of trails for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Domaine de la Baie Gillies
properties.Notes: Trails: 6 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing in four loops.

properties.Name: Station de ski du Mont-Orignal
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de ski du Mont-Orignal offers about 15 km of trails along the Etchemin River that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Station touristique du Massif du sud
properties.Notes: Trails: The Parc regional du Massif du Sud offers 42 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only). A chairlift ride to the top of the mountain gives access to an 18 km backcountry trail. Trails are rated Easy (slopes of 9% or less) Intermediate Difficult (slopes of 14-25%) and Extreme (slopes of 30%).

properties.Name: Centre de plein air de Sainte-Perpetue
properties.Notes: Trails: At Centre de plein air de Sainte-Perpetue 44 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Club sportif des Appalaches
properties.Notes: Trails: Club sportif des Appalaches grooms roughly 35 km of trails for cross-country skiing (classic only). There are two sections of trails: the Reseau Familial (8 km Easy/Intermediate) and the Reseau en Montagne (25 km Intermediate to Difficult).

properties.Name: Centre de plein air de Montmagny
properties.Notes: Trails: The Centre de plein air de Montmagny has 30 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 15 km for skating technique. The centre is also known as Jardin des Gelinottes and is part of the Parc des Appalaches.

properties.Name: Ski de fond des Grandes-Prairies
properties.Notes: Trails: Ski de fond des Grandes Prairies has 30 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing including 10 km for skating technique.

properties.Name: Centre de ski de fond Cap-Rouge
properties.Notes: Trails: There are 14 km of easy trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing at the Cap-Rouge golf course.

properties.Name: Centre de plein air Dansereau
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre de plein air Dansereau has 34 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing (classic technique only) operated by the town of Pont-Rouge. The trails connect with a 10-km linear trail along the Jacques-Cartier river to Sainte-Catherine.

properties.Name: Parc de la Gatineau
properties.Notes: Trails: Gatineau Park offers 185 km of trails for cross-country skiing of which 100 km are groomed for skating and classic. The 363 square km park north of Ottawa is operated by the National Capital Commission and is probably the largest groomed ski trail network in Canada.Trails are patrolled by professionals seven days a week aided by volunteers on weekends. Emergency phones are located at eight spots in the park.In February the Gatineau Loppet (formerly the Keskinada Loppet) one of 15 Worldloppets held each year attracts more than 3000 skiers in one of Canada's biggest cross-country skiing event. A free guided nature interpretation snowshoe tour is offered once a week.

properties.Name: Le Grand Portneuf
properties.Notes: Trails: Le Grand Portneuf offers 55 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing on a 36-hole golf course.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Centre Ski-neuf
properties.Notes: Trails: Centre Ski-neuf has about 24 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the local club.

properties.Name: Les Portes de l'Enfer
properties.Notes: Trails: At Les Portes de l'Enfer approximtely 30 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic only) by the town of Saint-Alban. More than half the trails are rated Difficult (perhaps that's the reason for its name "Gates of Hell").

properties.Name: Centre Nature Sainte-Basile
properties.Notes: Trails: The Centre Nature Saint-Basile offers 36 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing with 2 km lighted for night skiing.

properties.Name: Gite de l'Ecureuil
properties.Notes: Trails: Gite de l'Ecureuil offers 24 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing (classic technique).

properties.Name: Les Sapins Verts
properties.Notes: Trails: Les Sapins Verts ski centre has about 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Reserve faunique de Portneuf
properties.Notes: Trails: The Reserve faunique de Portneuf offers 50 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing. There are also 35 km of backcountry trails that can be used for hut-to-hut trips. The trails are in two sectors of the reserve Talbot and Travers.

properties.Name: Domaine Notre-Dame
properties.Notes: Trails: Domaine Notre-Dame has 14 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing. The non-for-profit family outdoor centre is open Friday to Sunday.

properties.Name: Village des Sports
properties.Notes: Trails: Village des Sports reportedly has 40 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Cypress Hills Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Cypress Hills Provincial Park offers 17 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: York Lake Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails: York Lake Regional Park has 11 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Esterhazy Cross Country Club Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Esterhazy Cross Country Club grooms 25 km of trails for cross-country skiing in and around Kaposvar Valley. Some trails are on flats others have extreme slopes and range from novice to expert level. A recent addition is six km of trail that are groomed for skating technique.

properties.Name: Duck Mountain Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Duck Mountain Provincial Park offers 50 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing plus another 20 km of backcountry trails. One trail connects with trails in Duck Mountain Regional Park. Together with the Kamsack Cross Country Ski Club the park hosts the annual Duck Mountain Cross Country Ski Loppet in late February.

properties.Name: Duck Mountain Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Duck Mountain Regional Park offers 15 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Rowan's Ravine Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Rowan's Ravine Provincial Park offers 6 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Manitou Beach (Watrous-Manitou Ski Club)
properties.Notes: Trails: At Manitou Beach 9 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Watrous-Manitou Ski Club.

properties.Name: Blue Mountain Outdoor Adventure Center (White Tail Resort)
properties.Notes: Trails: Blue Mountain Outdoor Adventure Center offers 40 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including 20 km of skating trails. The centre may only be open on weekends call ahead to check. The reort was the site of a 1999 Cross Country Skiing World Cup.

properties.Name: Battlefords Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: The Battlefords Provincial Park offers 25 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing when conditions permit. Note: This information is out of date and there is no cross-country ski information on the park's website.

properties.Name: Edam Ski Club Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Edam Ski Club Trails grooms 20 km of trails for cross-country skiing in two areas: Dulwich Ski Trails (11 km) and Horse Hill Ski Trails (9 km). Moonlight ski tours are held every full moon. Annual events: Horse Hill to Dulwich Mini-Birkie (last Sunday of School Break).

properties.Name: Moose Jaw River Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Moose Jaw River Park has three trails totalling about 12 km along the banks of the Moose Jaw River that are groomed for cross-country skiing. A 11 km section of the Trans Canada Trail and some other multi-use trails can also be used for skiing.

properties.Name: Makwa Lake Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Makwa Lake Provincial Park 21 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Meadow Lake Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: Meadow Lake Ski Club Trails grooms 20 km of trails for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Meadow Lake Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Meadow Lake Provincial Park offers 24 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Anglin Lake Ski Trails
