properties.Notes: Trails: Anglin Lake's 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including 6 km of skating lanes. There are three trails rated Easy and three trails rated Intermediate. The trails connect with the Spruce River Highland trail and the Kinowa Lake trail in Prince Albert National Park.

properties.Name: Emma Lake Recreation Site
properties.Notes: Trails: Emma Lake's 5.5 km Valleyview Trail is groomed for cross-country skiing and rated Intermediate.

properties.Name: Little Red River Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Prince Albert's Little Red River Park has 35 km of trails that are groomed by the Prince Albert Ski Club for cross-country skiing including 6 km of lighted trails for night skiing. The club hosts the Prince Albert Loppet in January.

properties.Name: Eb's Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Eb's Trails consist of more than 50 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Saskatoon Nordic Ski Club. Grooming is done sporadically as necessary. There are lots of single track and some double track. The trails have some difficult sections lots of intermediate sections and some easy sections.

properties.Name: Buffalo Pound Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Buffalo Pound Provincial Park has 5 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Carlton Trail Ski Club Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Carlton Trail Ski Club Trail grooms trails for cross-country skiing at both the Humboldt Golf Club and at the Dixon Ski Trails northwest of Humboldt.

properties.Name: Greenwater Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Greenwater Lake Provincial Park's 25 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing (single track with skating lane). All the trails are rated Intermediate.

properties.Name: Hudson Bay Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Hudson Bay Regional Park's Pineview trail system offers 30 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing in the "Moose Capital of the World".

properties.Name: Nipawin Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Nipawin & District Regional Park 10 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing on one side of the river and another 14 km of trails are on the other side.

properties.Name: Nipawin Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Just north of Niapwain 17 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing though only 9 km are groomed.

properties.Name: Narrow Hills Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: At Narrow Hills Provincial Park 21 km of trails are available for cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Candle Lake Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Candle Lake Provincial Park has 14 km of trails available for cross-country skiing in two areas of the park Bay Lake and Hilltop.

properties.Name: Lac La Ronge Provincial Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Lac La Ronge Provincial Park has 61 km of trails groomed for cross-country skiing including a 5-km trail lighted for night skiing. Trailheads are situated at two locations in the park Don Allen and Nut Point and are connected by the 18 km Saskaloppet trail. The Don Allen trails are the site of in the annual Don Allen Saskaloppet in early March and host of the 2008 Western Canadian Cross Country Ski Championships.

properties.Name: Weyburn Cross-Country Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: Weyburn's trails are not groomed for cross-country skiing but skiers make their own tracks at the Souris Valley grounds and Jubilee Park.Note: This information may be out of date and no recent data is available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Carlton Trail Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Carlton Trail Regional Park has 6 km of trails that are groomed for cross-country skiing the by Carlton Trail Ski Club.

properties.Name: Kluane National Park
properties.Notes: Trails: Several trails are groomed for cross-country skiing each located in a different area of the park. Some of the longer trails are suitable for backpacking ski tours.Along with two neighbouring parks Kluane is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Topping out at 6050 metres Mount Logan Canada's highest peak is located in the interior of the park surrounded by glaciers. Access to the glaciers is usually accomplished by aircraft and is advised only for those with proper glacier safety training.

properties.Name: Gray Mountain Biathlon Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: 45 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing including a 1 km lighted trail. There are also some backcountry trails. The centre was the site of the biathlon events of the 2007 Canada Winter Games.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Carcross Community Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: The slopes of Montana Montain are an excellent location for snowshoeing and backcountry skiing from mid-November until late April.

properties.Name: Aitlin Ski Club Trails
properties.Notes: Trails: About 10 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing by the Atlin Ski Club.

properties.Name: Dawson City Jackrabbit Cross Country Ski Club
properties.Notes: Trails: 7 km of trails are groomed for cross-country skiing.Note: This information may be out of date and there is no new data available. If you have any recent info about this destination please send us an e-mail.

properties.Name: Chestnut Valley
properties.Notes: Michigan Cup race site. The trail is groomed by Nubs nob and connects to Nubs Nob's trail system. The trails (at least during the last race there) were groomed wide enough that 2 skaters could ski side by side.

properties.Name: Pine Haven Recreation Area
properties.Notes: One of the Midland County Parks, Pine Haven is located in the woods along US10 near Sanford. Take the West River Road exit from US10 and follow the signs to the park. Trails (about 15K) are sometimes groomed (more reliably for classic). The upper-level beginner's loop is very flat, while several intermediate and advanced loops descend from the plateau to two small streams. No rentals or food, but there is a porta-john and often a ski patrol on weekends. No lighted trails.

properties.Name: Addison Oaks
properties.Notes: Addison Oaks is another Oakland County park north of Rochester that usually is groomed for both skating and classic. Last year (2001-2002) they didn't groom at all. I think because of lack of snow but it might have been budgetary. Addison has a great trail network, quite a bit of single track in the woods and a lot along open farm fields but in the shadow of tree lines to preserve snow. It's the same course they run Mt. Bike races on in the spring and fall (race coming up Sept. 15, 2002) I'll find out what the situation with grooming is there and let you know what they'll have this year. (By Michael Bliss)

properties.Name: Independence Oaks
properties.Notes: 10 minutes north of Pontiac, S.E. Michigan's best kept secret. Independence Oaks, an Oakland County Park, is accessible from I-75. Take exit 89, Sashabaw rd. North 3 miles entrance on your left. This park gets snow when everywhere else gets just a dusting. 6-8 week season plus, up to 3 months of skiing. Park maintenance grooms for skating and lays a track for classic. Warming hut and old classic rentals. Vending machines. Closes at dark. $5.00/day pass (Oakland Country residents, $8 everyone else), $20.00 for annual. Awesome hilly trails make you feel like your up north. You'll not believe your an hour from Detroit. Park service people though enthusiastic are not knowledgeable about trail conditions. They'll tell you no skiing when it's great back in the woods. (By Michael Bliss)

properties.Name: Crystal Mountain
properties.Notes: 40K groomed classic and skating. Site of several Michigan Cup races.

properties.Name: Proud Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Tracked (classic) skiing in the winter. Very flat. Warmup house.

properties.Name: Dune's Golf Course
properties.Notes: The Dune's Golf Course is near Empire, Mi. It's the desperation course for me when there isn't enough snow to go out on the normal areas around here. Quite a few skiers use this area throughout the winter. It has 18 fairways with nice rolling terrain. The grass they have planted there allows the snow to sit on top and it lasts pretty long even when it gets over 32f. We have been bugging the owner to groom a loop trail with no luck...so far. -Kevin Kelly.

properties.Name: Hanson Hills
properties.Notes: 35 km of wooded rolling terrain Groomed 14' wide with set track to accommodate classical & skating styles. Michigan Cup race site.

properties.Name: Lakes of the North
properties.Notes: 20K of nordic ski trails??

properties.Name: McGuire's Resort
properties.Notes: 10K of groomed trails (3K lighted for night skiing).

properties.Name: Hudson Mills Metropark
properties.Notes: Snow and grooming can be poor. Classic only. Warm Cross Country Ski Center.

properties.Name: Indian Springs Metropark
properties.Notes: Ten miles of groomed cross country ski trails, but snow and grooming can be poor.

properties.Name: Kensington Metropark
properties.Notes: Cross Country Ski Touring Center (Golf Course) with marked trails, rental equipment and food bar, but snow and grooming (classic only) can be poor. Some of the best trails overlap with the horse trails, and the horses can take out all the grooming.

properties.Name: Maybury State Park
properties.Notes: Used to do ski rental, but no longer. Groomed for classic only. Good combination of easy flat trails where you can ski 2-3 abreast or jump into the woods where others have skied. Very scenic. 17K of ski trails.

properties.Name: Otsego Ski Club/Hidden Valley Resort
properties.Notes: 10K of groomed trails. Michigan Cup Race Site

properties.Name: Detroit Mountain Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Trails flow around the base of Detroit Mountain downhill area.

properties.Name: Fort Snelling State Park
properties.Notes: The most popular trail is the Pike Island loop offering views of the confluence of the Mississippi and Minnesota Rivers.

properties.Name: Grass Lake
properties.Notes: Part of the Vadnais-Snail Lakes Park these trails have both wooded and marsh land characteristics. Easy to intermediate level of difficulty.

properties.Name: Tamarack Nature Center
properties.Notes: Ski through beautiful prairie woodland and marsh with abundant wildlife. 1km practice loop. Easy to intermediate level of difficulty. Visitor center with ski rental.

properties.Name: Pine Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located in the Tamarac National Wildlife Refuge.

properties.Name: Frontenac State Park
properties.Notes: Trails rated easy to challenging.

properties.Name: Nerstrand-Big Woods State Park
properties.Notes: All 6 miles of trail run through the Big Woods Landscape with portions along Prairie Creek and Hidden Falls waterfall. Park manager recommends skiers walk the short portion of difficult terrain down Hidden Falls Trail to access the intermediate to easy rolling terrain.

properties.Name: Sibley State Park
properties.Notes: Intermediate to challenging trails with lots of ups and downs. Double tracked predominantly one-way loop trails. Skate ski from park office to Mt. Tom for a spectacular winter panoramic view of the area.

properties.Name: Flandrau State Park
properties.Notes: The park maintains 8 miles of groomed cross-country ski trail. Cross-country skiers enjoy the flat trails on the bottom of the valley or more challenging routes on the oak-shaded bluffs.

properties.Name: Forestville/Mystery Cave State Park
properties.Notes: 11 miles of cross-country ski trails of which 8.5 miles are groomed. More than 60 miles of ski trail are available near the park on the Root River Trail System. Primarily intermediate skill level. Grooming is usually done on Fridays for the weekend.

properties.Name: Chester Woods Park
properties.Notes: This is a county park that contains 1300 acres. They groom about 5 miles of trails. The park is both wooded and hilly and the trails are well marked with maps at most intersections.

properties.Name: Eastwood Golf Course
properties.Notes: The main training course in Rochester. Usually groomed regularly it can get a bit hardpacked between snowfalls.

properties.Name: Soldier's Field Golf Course
properties.Notes: Nice quiet trails right in the city on the golf course. With the city light you can see the trails fairly well at night.

properties.Name: Great River Bluffs State Park
properties.Notes: Trails rated easy to moderate.

properties.Name: Lindenwood Park Ski Trails
properties.Notes: A flat trail that follows the Red River of the North along its floodplain. 10km groomed for classical 4km for skating.

properties.Name: Balsam Branch Trails
properties.Notes: The Balsam Branch trails are open to the public for no charge. When there is snow tracks are set by Polk County Park and volunteers. The trailhead parking area is always well plowed. Toilet facilities are available at the nearby Kennedy Environmental center but no coffee shop or warming facility. Roughly 4K of lighted trails added in 2010.

properties.Name: Ashland Ski Trail
properties.Notes: A beautiful trail right in the city of Ashland. The full 6.3 kilometers of the trail are tracked for classic style skiing and most are groomed for skate style skiing as well.

properties.Name: After Hours Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Mostly easy to moderate with a few challenging hills. Best known for good grooming and scenic views of the Brule River. Groomed for both classic and skating. Home to the River View Loppet Race in March.

properties.Name: Anvil National Recreation Trail
properties.Notes: Forested terrain varies from mostly level (West Trail East Trail) to rolling hills (Ninemile Trail Lake Loop) to hilly (Devil's Run). Chickadees waiting to eat birdseed from your hand at the warming shelter. Toilets are available at the parking area and warming shelter.

properties.Name: Nicolet North Trail
properties.Notes: Forested terrain varies from nearly level (Ash Meadow Camp 22) to mostly rolling (Roller Coaster Run The Gulch Pat Shay Trail Narrow Gauge Loop) to several scattered hills. This trail connects with the Anvil National Recreation Trail.

properties.Name: Nordmarka Ski Trails
properties.Notes: This trail is maintained by the Nordmarka Ski Club of Eagle River.

properties.Name: Lake Forest Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Part of the Lake Forest Recreation Area Golf Course.

properties.Name: Tower Ridge Ski Area
properties.Notes: Great trails--hills and flats--for all levels. Groomed for both classical and skating. There are about 3km of lighted trails.

properties.Name: Birkie Trail
properties.Notes: The famous Birkie trail. A great rolling trail through the woods between Cable and Hayward. There is a short section south at Hwy OO that is lighted. There are snowmaking trails at the Start area.

properties.Name: Hixon Forest
properties.Notes: The trails are groomed by the City of La Crosse Park Department after each snowfall. They are groomed for skate-skiing and classic skiing.

properties.Name: Hoffman Hills
properties.Notes: Challenging trails located 10 miles NE of Menomonie.

properties.Name: Red Cedar River Trail
properties.Notes: A groomed stretch from Menomonie to Downsville. Red Cedar Outfitters offer return van rides for a one-way ski trip. Follow direction signs from I-94.

properties.Name: Minocqua Winter Park Nordic Center
properties.Notes: PistenBully groomed trails (with 12 km groomed for classic-only) 2 km lighted and 15km of power-tilled single-track ski trails. Glaciated terrain provides for a wide range of beginner to expert level trails and a telemark slope. On-site amenities include a chalet with PSIA certified ski school and& ski shop food service and a heated waxing room.

properties.Name: Levis/Trow Mound Trail
properties.Notes: The trail system consists of approximately fifteen miles of groomed trail and another ten of ungroomed backcountry routes. The more advanced trails are located north and west of Levis on Trow Mound while intermediate and easy trails lay near the base of Levis Mound. All groomed trails are set with diagonal tracks and a skating lane averaging 12 feet wide. Depending on snow conditions the trail is generally groomed twice per week. Trail passes are required. Facilities include a new cross-country ski chalet running water mens and womens bathrooms.

properties.Name: Afterglow Lake Resort
properties.Notes: Afterglow Ski Trails are groomed for skate and classic 5-7 times a week with a Tidd Tech G2. The full width groomed trails are protected by a thick mixed hardwood forest with trees right to the trails edge. A large heated warm up room is perfect to wait for the diehards in your group. UP snowbelt for reliable snow.

properties.Name: Timberland Hills West
properties.Notes: Right next door to the famous Timberland Hills trails this is a short section that is lighted until around 11 pm.

properties.Name: Razorback Ridges Trail
properties.Notes: Mixed forest and open field terrain varies from nearly level to mostly hilly with several scattered hills. All 18 trail segments are groomed and only 2 segments groomed exclusively for classical. McKay's Corner Store located at the trailhead offers warming shelter food and beverages.

properties.Name: Plover River Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Mostly wooded terrain along segments of Plover River. Warming shelter open on weekends. Located off Hwy 66 east of Stevens Point past the airport; turn right at Plover River Trail sign.

properties.Name: Hiram Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Another set of trails within the Foot Hills State Forest these are rated from novice to expert.

properties.Name: Greenwood Hills Trail
properties.Notes: This trail is located on hilly terrain just east of the Wausau City limits on Greenwood Hills Golf Course. This golf course skiing provides challenging climbs and exhilarating downhills. The trail includes wooded sections.

properties.Name: ABR
properties.Notes: ABR is a full service touring center located on scenic and varied terrain along the Montreal River in Ironwood Michigan. Trailhead cabin retail ski shop rentals and lessons available. They have state of the art grooming equipment including Pisten Bully powertillers and groom daily. Open at 9 AM daily from November to April 1st.

properties.Name: Swedetown Trails
properties.Notes: Beginner to expert trails. 4.5k lighted until 10 p.m. Host to the annual Great Bear Chase. Up down turns mixed stands of forest and clearings provide an exciting terrain for the skier. The flow of the trail is Swedetown's specialty. The trail is meticulously groomed and the addition of a warming chalet and lighted trail have made Swedetown hard to beat.

properties.Name: Maasto Hiihto Ski Trails
properties.Notes: The trail is located in the city of Hancock and can be accessed from many points. The main trailhead is located at the Houghton County Arena. Easy to expert trails pass a picnic spot and beautiful vistas.

properties.Name: Deep Portage Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located in the Deep Portage Conservation Reserve the trails are rated novice to expert.

properties.Name: Hill Street Classic Trails
properties.Notes: Trails range from easy to difficult. Part of the Superior Nordic Training and Recreation Area. Located directly west of Suicide Bowl Trails.

properties.Name: Porcupine Mountains Wilderness State Park
properties.Notes: Enjoy the quiet splendor of wooded trails and breathtaking vistas blanketed in winter white from any of the Porkies cross-country trails. A unique one-ride lift ticket provides a quick access to the heart of the Nordic trail system from the Chalet.

properties.Name: Twin Lakes State Park
properties.Notes: Easy to moderate trails provide a view of Lake Superior at the scenic overlook sight. All trails are maintained on a volunteer effort. Parking and the trailhead are at the DNR Field Office.

properties.Name: Macbride Nature Recreation Area
properties.Notes: The trails are mostly wide and gentle with about 4 km of very challenging terrain. The system is groomed weekly or after a snowfall.

properties.Name: Lake Bronson State Park
properties.Notes: Trails are rated easy. The park plans to add 2.3 more miles of trail to the system for winter 2000-2001.

properties.Name: Itasca State Park
properties.Notes: Here you will find the Headwaters to the Mississippi amongst towering pines. Trails are easy to difficult.

properties.Name: Soaring Eagle Trail
properties.Notes: Groomed classical/skate trails wind through a varied forest ranging from baby aspen to mature balsam and pine. Trails vary from easy to advanced. There is also a one-mile blazed showshoe trail warming house and outdoor toilet.

properties.Name: Three Island Park
properties.Notes: This is an area of exceptional beauty with trails winding along Three Island Lake and Turtle River.

properties.Name: Cut Lake Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Located in the Foot Hills State Forest the trails are rated from novice to expert.

properties.Name: Shingobee Recreation Area Trails
properties.Notes: Running along the slopes of the Shingobee River Valley of the Chippewa National Forest these are rated from novice to expert. 3k are now being groomed for skating.

properties.Name: Zippel Bay State Park
properties.Notes: 6K groomed for skating and about 12K groomed for classic. Trails are definately beginner friendly and pass through a variety of forest types including jack pine birch aspen spruce-balsam and some low-land brush. One section passes through an old gravel pit.

properties.Name: Glendalough State Park
properties.Notes: One of the last large tracts of undeveloped lakeshore in western Minnesota (9.2 miles) lies within the park. The gently rolling topography is an excellent example of original landscape transition from prairie to northern hardwoods. This hilly lake-strewn and partially wooded countryside is an excellent setting for x-country skiing. Most trails are fairly level and easy to ski.

properties.Name: Pine Beach Trail
properties.Notes: Cragun's has upgrade the grooming in recent years. Connects with Legacy Trails.

properties.Name: Crow Wing State Park
properties.Notes: Nice trails through the woods along the Mississippi River. Novice to Intermediate.

properties.Name: Buena Vista Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Home course for the Minnesota Finlandia and Snowjourn races. It's a great course with lots of ups and downs and mainly in the woods.

properties.Name: Lutsen Mountains Nordic Trails
properties.Notes: Ski trails are located around the downhill slopes and are accessible by gondola and chair lifts. Your Nordic Center ticket allows you to ride the lifts up the mountains and then gradually descend groomed tracked trails into the Poplar River valley through a mixed forest of aspen birch maples and evergreens.

properties.Name: Lake Carlos State Park
properties.Notes: Classic-only trails are moderate in difficulty and cover rolling terrain.

properties.Name: George Wyth State Park
properties.Notes: Trails are primarily flat and run over bike paths as well as hiking paths. Groomed for skating and classic.

properties.Name: Warner Lake Park
properties.Notes: The 3.5 miles of trails loop through beautiful hardwood and pines and around the lake. Trail segments for all abilities.

properties.Name: Quarry Park and Nature Preserve
properties.Notes: The 4.2 miles of trails loop through trees wetlands prairies and past granite quarries and rock remnants. Trails are rated Easy and Intermediate. Parts of the trails are groomed for skate skiing along with the classic. Check out the four miles of lighted trails.

properties.Name: Milaca Trails
properties.Notes: The city of Milaca trails are single tracked and groomed for traditional skiiing. These trails are open to mountain biking (12 mi.) in the non-snow season.

properties.Name: Mississippi River County Park
properties.Notes: The 3.5 miles of trails loop through pines and hardwood forest and offer beautiful views of the Mississippi River. The trails are rated as easy.

properties.Name: Rock Lake
properties.Notes: This is a system of classic-only trails made up of ever increasing inter-connected loops through some of the loveliest country in the Midwest. Very hilly -- intermediate to advanced skills recommended.

properties.Name: Mukwonago Trail
properties.Notes: A beautiful challenging system of loops located about 17 miles east of Hayward. Trails are for intermediate to advanced skill levels and offer a great "in the woods" skiing experience.

properties.Name: North Lakeland Discovery Center
properties.Notes: The terrain is gentle and winds through the woods along the lake bog and nearby Manitowish River. There is also a warming/changing room with free hot apple cider and cookies. Trails are maintained by volunteers at the Discovery Center.

properties.Name: Black River Falls State Forest
properties.Notes: Some of the finest ski-touring trails in Wisconsin. Parking can be found at the Wildcat Lot about 4 miles NE of Millston and at Smrekar Lot about 4 miles east of Millston. Trails run through woodlands and rolling terrain. There are 9 loops totaling 24 miles and most trails are designated one-way. Ridge Norway Pine and Wildcat trails have very steep sections and are recommended for experts.

properties.Name: Collinwood Park
properties.Notes: 4 miles of classic groomed trails. Intermediate level. Trails go through woods and open grass lands view of Collinwood Lake and wetlands. Deer turkey and pheasants are likely to be seen.

properties.Name: Montissippi Park
properties.Notes: Two miles of classic groomed trails. These trails are set on a paved trail. Flat trails through a pine plantation next to the Mississippi River. Good for first time or beginner skiers.

properties.Name: Otsego Park
properties.Notes: 1.5 miles of classic groomed trails. Trail overlooks Mississippi River woods and native prairie. Good for beginners.

properties.Name: Stanley Eddy Park Reserve
properties.Notes: Two units with a combined 7.5 miles of trail. Trail is very hilly excellent big woods environment. Experienced skiers.

properties.Name: Robert Ney Regional Park
properties.Notes: 3.5 miles of classic groomed trails. Marshes and forest canopy excellent area to view wildlife. Intermediate skiers will enjoy this park. With small hills and flat areas it is an excellent destination.

properties.Name: Harry Larson County Forest
properties.Notes: Two miles of classic groomed trails. Just North of Lake Maria State Park this is and excellent warm up. With rolling terrain mature oak forest with pockets of big tooth aspen this is primarily for the intermediate skiers.

properties.Name: Kaplan's Woods Parkway
properties.Notes: Multi-use trail with 7 km of trails in hardwood forest and 3 km adjacent along bikeway lit for night skiing. Ravine terrain provides challenging hills. Wide trails suitable for skating tracked for classic when snow is sufficient.

properties.Name: Hickory Ridge Trail
properties.Notes: This trail winds through quiet and scenic oak and aspen forests. All loops are challenging to the skier with rolling to steep grades. All loops are signed with either a snowflake blazer or a blazer depicting a skier complete with kilometer markings. Ski trail rest shelters are located at the North and South loops. The entire system is groomed for both traditional and skate skiing. No dogs permitted.

properties.Name: Eagle Lake Regional Park
properties.Notes: The trail is located about two blocks West of Hwy 169 on Bass Lake Rd. Overall this is a nice little gem. The terrain is very gentle and seems an ideal place for a family with small children or beginner skiers.

properties.Name: East River Valley Park/Carr's Woods
properties.Notes: Nearly level trail through densely wooded flood plain. This trail is one of the best in Iowa because of the protection afforded by the dense tree cover. Trail is groomed for classic and skating on Fridays by local enthusiasts.

properties.Name: Sister's Farm
properties.Notes: Growing from a few classical trails this area now includes a fine skate trail that parallels the Flambeau River. Classical trails on west side skate east side.

properties.Name: Iowa State University Cross County Course
properties.Notes: This one of only two or three trail systems in the US that is dedicated to cross country running. The trail winds along College Creek in the wooded ISU Arboretuem and out into open fields. It has moderately rolling terrain with several challenging hills. The trail has very good turf cover but unfortunately is not groomed regularly. Usually there is a classic track established by local use. Skating can be great on this trail if the snow conditions are right.

properties.Name: Ellis Park
properties.Notes: Classic grooming on the very rolling hills of Ellis Park Golf Course. Best trails within the city limits.

properties.Name: Cedar Valley Trail
properties.Notes: The trail is a multi-use trail for biking hiking and cross-country skiing.

properties.Name: Blackwater Environmental Area
properties.Notes: Blackwater Environmental Area was developed in 1999 by Minnesota Power and includes a warming shack and lighted trails groomed of skating and a single-track classic. Terrain is beginner-level and very gently rolling.

properties.Name: Decorah Trail System
properties.Notes: Decorah has a variety of loops and trails. Groomed for skating and diagonal. Beginner to expert. Very pretty along the Upper Iowa River. Oneota Drive Recreational Trail has 1 mile of lighted trail and winds along the upper Iowa River and scenic Phelps Park bluffs. Palisade Park offers great views of Decorah and has 2 miles of intermediate to advanced trails. Van Peenen Park offers 4 miles of classic double-track.

properties.Name: St. Croix Bluffs Regional Park
properties.Notes: St. Croix Bluffs Regional Park is a 579 acre Regional Park located on the wild and scenic St. Croix River. The park offers a variety of landscape types including rolling upland fields wooded ravines and 3/4 mile of river frontage.

properties.Name: Cottage Grove Ravine Regional Park
properties.Notes: 4.9 miles of ski trail that are skate and classic. Also there are 5.5 miles of multi-use packed trail for walkers fat bikes and skijoring. This area has several hills and heavily wooded ravines.

properties.Name: Reforestation Camp
properties.Notes: Part of the Brown County Park system. Roughly 3.5K of lighted trails.

properties.Name: Triangle Sports Area
properties.Notes: Located along the Baird Creek Parkway there are nearly 4K of classical only trails. Also known locally as Bairds Creek.

properties.Name: Lakewood XC Ski Trails
properties.Notes: The Lakewood Ski Trail winds through beautiful wooded settings with rolling hills.

properties.Name: Valley Spur
properties.Notes: Located just outside the city wonderful rolling hills with some real challenging sections. Loads of lake effect snow in the winter.

properties.Name: Watersmeet Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located in Ottawa National Forest Sylvania Wilderness and Recreation Area. Groomed by Sylvania Outfitters.

properties.Name: Iola Winter Sports Club Trails
properties.Notes: Open to the public on weekends and some weekday evenings (fee). They have over 6K of lighted trails.

properties.Name: Neshota Park
properties.Notes: Trails are located a few miles outside of Green Bay and are rated from easy to advanced with challenging hills.

properties.Name: Palmquist's The Farm
properties.Notes: Trailheads located right on "The Farm" take you into 20 miles of ski trails through some of Wisconsin's most remote and beautiful forests and back country from beginner to intermediate-level ratings. You'll glide through maple groves and cedar swamps up hardwood ridges and into the Tiaga ski region just north of "The Farm." There is also about 1K of lighted trail. Four more miles of skating trails are also accessible from "The Farm."

properties.Name: McKeever Hills
properties.Notes: These trails are located about 15 miles south of Munising and are part of the Hiawatha National Forest. Grooming is on a somewhat irregular basis and trails (three loops) are rated easy to difficult. Described as very wooded and scenic with more of a "backcountry" feel. There's also a rustic cabin for rent near this trail.

properties.Name: Rapid River Ski Trail
properties.Notes: This trail system is part of the Hiawatha National Forest and is ranked easy to moderate. It offers three loops providing easy access for beginners rolling hills for advanced skiers and steeper slopes for experts. The trailhead is located 7 miles north of Rapid River on US 41.

properties.Name: Uller Trail
properties.Notes: These trails wind through some beautiful remote areas along the Penokee Range.

properties.Name: Jones Spring Area Trail
properties.Notes: A wide range of trails overlooking lakes and flowing through a variety of terrain.

properties.Name: Underdown Recreation Area
properties.Notes: Recreation area includes dozens of small lakes and ponds. Trail system contains of three loops: blue red and green segments. They may additionally groom Loop Road for skating.

properties.Name: Vasaloppet Public Ski Area
properties.Notes: Also known as the Vasaloppet practice area. Located about 12 miles north of Mora. Uses much of the Vasaloppet trail system near the start of the race. Open throughout the season.

properties.Name: Lauterman National Recreation Trail
properties.Notes: Trails from beginner to intermediate. Nice Adirondack-style shelter. Connects with Perch Trail.

properties.Name: Zillmer Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located in the North Kettle Moraine State Forest near the Ice Age Trail Visitor Center.

properties.Name: Barkhausen Waterfowl Preserve
properties.Notes: Fairly flat terrain through forests meadows and wetlands.

properties.Name: Heartwood Ski Trails
properties.Notes: The Heartwood Conference Center and Resort grooms over 25K of cross country ski trails for both classic and skate skiing. A diverse selection of trails and terrain offers satisfaction to both the novice and expert skier.

properties.Name: Bear Head Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Located just west of Ely beautiful rolling trails through woods and near Bear Head Lake.

properties.Name: Pattison State Park
properties.Notes: The park features Wisconsin's highest waterfall as the Black River winds through. Trails range from beginner to moderate.

properties.Name: Magney-Snively Trail
properties.Notes: The Magney-Snively trail has 14k of trail for intermediate and advanced skiers. This trail offers skiing through a beautiful hardwood forest with large hills and trees. This terrain is rugged and therefore is not recommended for beginners. The trail loops clockwise.

properties.Name: Barsness Park
properties.Notes: Trails wind through the park's 150-acre wildlife preserve. Located on the south end of Glenwood. A technical hilly course.

properties.Name: Riverside Park
properties.Notes: Flat to rolling hills right in downtown St. Cloud just above the Mississippi River.

properties.Name: Ladysmith High School Trails
properties.Notes: A lighted 1.4K loop on the eastside of Ladysmith High School.

properties.Name: Kivela Road Trail
properties.Notes: Located at Kivela Road Park. Three groomed loops for beginners intermediate and advance.

properties.Name: Lake Wissota State Park
properties.Notes: Located just east of Chippewa Falls on the NE shore of Lake Wissota.

properties.Name: Brown's Creek Nature Preserve
properties.Notes: Located on the western edge of Stillwater a primarily flat to moderate course with classic and skating.

properties.Name: Rum River Central Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails wind through a slightly hilly section of old growth forest along the Rum River.

properties.Name: Hidden Valley Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Easy to advanced. These trails connect to the Silver Rapids Trails. 1K lighted loop. Chalet open on weekends from Christmas through mid-March.

properties.Name: Drummond Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Located less than a mile south of Drummond. One of thje most popular trails Boulevard is double tracked so you can ski side by side.

properties.Name: Jack Lake Trails
properties.Notes: A series of six loops designed to be an easy family-style ski area with 1 loop designed specifically for the expert.

properties.Name: Greywalls
properties.Notes: Deceptively rugged trail on a new section of the Marquette Golf Course.

properties.Name: Noquemanon Trail
properties.Notes: Lower Noquemanon trail a point to point trail leading from Co. Rd. 510 in Negaunee Township to the Superior Dome in Marquette. A beautifully wooded trail that is encompassed by Upper Peninsula wilderness. Three trailheads: County Road 510 Forestville Rd and Superior Dome. Upper segment only groomed for the Noquemanon ski race.

properties.Name: VA Medical Center
properties.Notes: Located across the street from Apollo High School the flat grass field (one small hill) is groomed and offers a decent low snow skiing option.

properties.Name: Banning State Park
properties.Notes: Beautiful classical trails through the woods and along the Kettle River with its scenic rapids.

properties.Name: Sand Dunes State Forest
properties.Notes: Rolling trails through the Bob Dunn Recreation Area at Lake Ann in Sand Dunes State Forest. Five loops: Green and South Red (Campground) Loops are beginner mostly level; Blue Yellow and North Red Loops are Intermediate and the Orange Loops is a hilly "More Difficult". Ski trails adopted and maintained by Backcountry Trail Patrol.

properties.Name: Potawatomi State Park
properties.Notes: Located on the shores of Sturgeon Bay just northwest of the city of Sturgeon Bay. Terrain is gently rolling upland bordered by steep slopes and rugged limestone cliffs.

properties.Name: Crossroads at Big Creek
properties.Notes: Located in the heart of Door County the Crossroads at Big Creek is a nature preserve with a ski trail system.

properties.Name: Stuart River Ski Trails
properties.Notes: These trails provide an excellent opportunity to see deer moose and timberwolves.

properties.Name: Kinnickinnic State Park
properties.Notes: Easy classic trails through the woods and prairies. Kinni is a quiet park that includes a terrific overlook view of the St. Croix River.

properties.Name: Fond du Lac State Forest
properties.Notes: The trail is on rolling terrain meandering through a mixed hardwood and deciduous forest. This is an actively managed forest so the scenery may change from one season to another. Expect to see signs of moose deer and timber wolves sometimes sharing the groomed trail. The difficulty level is predominantly easy to moderate with some expert level on the east end of the system. From I35 go west on Hwy 210 about 17 miles to CR 120. Go north and east 4 mi to trailhead.

properties.Name: Sheboygan Jaycee Trails
properties.Notes: The trail system runs through three contiguous city parks: Jaycee Park Evergreen Park and Maywood Environmental Park. The main trail follows the Pigeon River and is fairly flat rising a few times into the bluffs above the river. Roughly 3K lit trail in Evergreen Park.

properties.Name: Nashotah Park
properties.Notes: Nashotah Park features three loops on gently rolling to hilly terrain.

properties.Name: Point Beach State Forest
properties.Notes: Located along the shores of Lake Michigan.

properties.Name: Listening Inn
properties.Notes: The Listening Inn Bed & Breakfast grooms a classic-only trail system that winds through varying terrain; open meadows hardwoods and virgin stands of pine. Several loops range from fairly easy to more advanced. Donations are requested for day skiers.

properties.Name: Gartzke Flowage
properties.Notes: Scenic trails with a diverse topography. Recreation shelter and restrooms. Maintained by Antigo Bike and Ski Club.

properties.Name: Lutsen/Spruce Creek
properties.Notes: Includes the Massie Hall Isaks Flats Meadows and Golf Course loops of the North Shore ski trails with connections to Sugarbush and Cascade systems.

properties.Name: Grand View Lodge - The Pines
properties.Notes: Gentle trails running through The Pines Golf course at Grand View Lodge. Trails groomed by Ginzugroomer on a daily basis mostly classical with about 10K skating. Mostly Intermediate to some Expert.

properties.Name: Beaver Brook Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Located just south of Spooner. Primarily backcountry trails classical only.

properties.Name: Tomahawk Lake Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Single track one way classical only (skating added fall 2017) trail in rolling terrain through hardwood and pine forest with scenic vistas of small lakes. Fast downhill runs with safe glide outs make the main loop more challenging.

properties.Name: Irvine Park
properties.Notes: Gently rolling terrain through a mature mixed hardwood forest. The park offers a zoo petting zoo scenic dam museum and other historical displays.

properties.Name: Schlecht Lake
properties.Notes: Rolling loops between and around two lakes. 2.5K are lighted. Located just off Leary Road 1.5 miles south of downtown Minocqua off Hwy 51.

properties.Name: Navarino Wildlife Area
properties.Notes: 15000-acre Navarino Wildlife Area with open fields conifer swamps hardwood forests pine plantations and aspen/oak forests.

properties.Name: Larson Lake
properties.Notes: Roughly 7km groomed for skating (outer loop plus interior segment). Rolling hills of hardwoods and some mature red and white pines.

properties.Name: Northwood Golf Course
properties.Notes: The trails traverse through a gently rolling forested area adjacent to the golf course with a small portion of the trails on golf course property. The trails are well suited for beginner to intermediate skiers with a one-kilometer skate trail on steep hills for the adventurous expert skier. Trailhead is at the golf course driving range.

properties.Name: Chomonix Golf Course
properties.Notes: Mostly flat terrain about half the trail is in the open the rest in the woods.

properties.Name: CedarHurst
properties.Notes: CedarHurst Lodge offers 5K of on-site trails primarily classic with some sections for skating. Expansion of the trails to 13K is planned.

properties.Name: Moccasin Ski Trail
properties.Notes: The trail weaves its course through ever changing scenery dominated by maples then birch pine and hemlock. It oversees two river basins: the Prairie flowing west and Hunting flowing east.

properties.Name: Kettlebowl Ski Trail
properties.Notes: The trail weaves its course through changing scenery of primarily Northern Hardwood and Aspen forest types which are typical of Langlade County. The topography includes high ridges and rolling hills.

properties.Name: Maranatha Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Located in Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest this trail system offers four interconnected loops rated moderate to difficult. Maintained by the privately-run Silver Birch Ranch. Parking along south side of Sawyer Lake Rd.

properties.Name: Human Powered Trails
properties.Notes: Located next to Hixon Forest on top of scenic Grandad Bluff.

properties.Name: Hormel Nature Center
properties.Notes: The J.C. Hormel Nature Center offers classic tracks and roughly 10K of skate skiing segments.

properties.Name: Lime Creek Nature Center
properties.Notes: About 5K groomed open country skate ski trails with another 10K groomed woodland classic ski trails.

properties.Name: Justin Trails Resort
properties.Notes: Wide trails groomed for classic and freestyle nordic skiing. The trails vary in difficulty and length. Some provide great vistas of the surrounding valleys and hills of southwest Wisconsin.

properties.Name: Morgan Creek Park
properties.Notes: The 236-acre park includes a modern campground cross-country ski trails open shelter and arboretum.

properties.Name: Wickiup Hill Trails
properties.Notes: Trails flow through wetland prairie woodland and savanna. Beautiful Wickiup Hill Outdoor Learning Area built in 2002.

properties.Name: Camden State Park
properties.Notes: Situated along the wooded Redwood River valley with over 170 feet of elevation change. The ski trail parallels the river down in the valley. Mostly groomed for classical skiing.

properties.Name: Cassian Two-Way Ski Trail
properties.Notes: The trail is groomed for tracked skiing only. There is two way traffic so please keep to the right.

properties.Name: Peninsula State Park
properties.Notes: Roughly 16 miles of classical tracks with six miles also groomed for skating.

properties.Name: Riverside Trail
properties.Notes: Niagara's Riverside Trails borders the Menominee River in Niagara Wisconsin. Beautiful woods wetlands and river valley. Many intersecting trails allow short loops long loops and a good variety of terrain.

properties.Name: Maple Lane Ski Center
properties.Notes: Classical only trails indoor area with snackbar fireplace and restroom. Trails are groomed often on an as needed basis.

properties.Name: Audubon Center of the North Woods
properties.Notes: The trails go through mixed forest and one section is in an open wetland area. The Center is located 6 miles east of Sandstone on Grindstone Lake. Open to the public.

properties.Name: Big Bay Pathway
properties.Notes: Three main loops from beginner to expert. Locted just a mile west of town.

properties.Name: Wolf Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: The terrain is level to hilly. The forest is a mixture of hardwoods and mature pine.

properties.Name: Vadnais/Sucker Lakes
properties.Notes: Trails wind around Sucker and Vadnais lakes. Generally flat terrain.

properties.Name: Totogatic Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Terrain ranges from flat to rolling and is groomed for traditional skiing only.

properties.Name: Quarry Hill Park
properties.Notes: Rolling terrain around the site of an old Quarry located right in Rochester. Trail developed and maintained by volunteer crew.

properties.Name: U of M - North Central Exp. Station
properties.Notes: Mostly level through forest; rated beginner-intermediate. Trail winds through forest including old-growth red and white pine.

properties.Name: Cam-Rock Park
properties.Notes: This park is in three separate sections. The longest trail is in section 2 and section 3 in Rockdale has a steeper hill.

properties.Name: Barron Area Nordic Trail Association
properties.Notes: The trail system runs through a mix of mature oak-maple forest and open field skiing. The trail is located on the south side of the City of Barron Wisconsin just south of the High School football field. 3.3K of lighted trail.

properties.Name: Whitefish Dunes State Park
properties.Notes: The park features forests and dunes along the rugged coast of Lake Michigan and include a large expanse of sandy beach and the highest dunes in the state.

properties.Name: Big Creek State Park
properties.Notes: The trail network utilizes the disc golf course and other park grounds adjacent to Big Creek Lake. The terrain is level to gently rolling. Trails offer nice views of the lake and cross a mixture of natural habitats that harbor many birds and other wildlife.

properties.Name: Miljes Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Milje's ski trails are located 1 mile south of Wakefield Mi in the heart of the U.P.'s snowbelt. Gentle classic only trails through a mix of hardwood forests and cedar swamps make this area a gem to experience.

properties.Name: Valleywood Golf Course
properties.Notes: The local school district Nordic ski team grooms some trails (weather permitting). Always park outside of the gate even if it is open.

properties.Name: Nose Lake Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Two main loops groomed classic only. Dogs are allowed on the trail but must be kept under control at all times.

properties.Name: Governor Dodge State Park
properties.Notes: Eighteen miles of ski trails are groomed and tracked as conditions permit. Mainly classical with a couple kilometers skating accessible from the Gold Mine trailhead. The varying terrain offers challenges for all skiers. Flush toilets water tables and grills are provided at the trailhead.

properties.Name: Cherokee Marsh - South Unit
properties.Notes: Classic trails through marsh and woods along the Yahara River.

properties.Name: West Torch Trail
properties.Notes: The West Torch Ski Trail is a narrow classic trail. The two short loops are suitable for beginner or novice skiers. The terrain is flat to gently rolling. The eastern portion of the 5.9 and 8.1 Km loops traverse a somewhat steeper hill and provides more excitement.

properties.Name: Namakegon Trail
properties.Notes: The trail is fairly flat and suitable for beginner or novice skiers.

properties.Name: Rice Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Trails are groomed frequently. Smooth terrain along Rice Lake and through wooded and prairie scenes.

properties.Name: Swan Lake Ski Trails
properties.Notes: This system of trails runs on the moderately rolling terrain of the Eagle Creek Golf Course. Trail head is situated between Eagle Creek and Swan Lake and offers a great skiing experience for any level of skier. Groomed and maintained by volunteers of the Willmar Nordic Ski Club.

properties.Name: Manka Trail
properties.Notes: Lighted trail through the woods behind elementary school in International Falls.

properties.Name: Springvale County Park
properties.Notes: Mildly rolling to level trails in multiple loops through prairie and woods.

properties.Name: Spirit River Nature Area
properties.Notes: Trails roll through the woods along the Rum River in the West Park section.

properties.Name: Moose Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Easy to moderate skiing.

properties.Name: Lake Minnewashta Regional Park
properties.Notes: Trails meander along the edge of Lake Minnewashta through forested and prairie area of this 340-acre park. Separate trails are groomed for skiing and walking.

properties.Name: Baylor Regional Park
properties.Notes: Offers several kilometers of traditional groomed trails which meander through settings of woodland prairies and along lakeshore.

properties.Name: Amen Lake
properties.Notes: Between Amen and Long Lakes; rated beginner/intermediate.

properties.Name: Wildcat Mountain State Park
properties.Notes: On a steep ridge overlooking the scenic Kickapoo River Valley Wildcat Mountain State Park offers skiing trails with spectacular views.

properties.Name: Hok-Si-La Municipal Park
properties.Notes: Hok-Si-La is a 252 acre park located on the Minnesota side of Lake Pepin in Lake City.

properties.Name: Buffalo River State Park
properties.Notes: Trails wind through one of Minnesota's finest and largest remnant prairies along the Buffalo River.

properties.Name: Alimagnet Park
properties.Notes: Short relatively flat trails. The park has been used for skijoring in recent years.

properties.Name: Machickanee
properties.Notes: The trails lead through forests over topography ranging from creek bottoms to ridge tops. Numerous hills and curves of various slopes and lengths make this course a challenge for the intermediate to advanced skiers. There is also a beginners loop for all ability levels.

properties.Name: Coon Rapids Dam Regional Park
properties.Notes: Primarily flat trails along the Mississippi River north and south of the Coon Rapids Dam.

properties.Name: Indian Lake Park
properties.Notes: Cross-country ski and nature trails wind through the wooded hills and there is a log cabin warming house.

properties.Name: Rock Cut State Park
properties.Notes: Winding trail system best accessed from Lions Club parking lot.

properties.Name: Drugan's Golf Course
properties.Notes: Golf course skiing in the La Crosse area.

properties.Name: Big Ridge
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate. Trail runs through rolling forest of hardwoods and evergreens. Expert loops have some steep hills.

properties.Name: University of Iowa Ashton Cross-Country Course
properties.Notes: The entire area is well maintained during the non-snow months which means ski grooming can take place with light snow.

properties.Name: Lincoln Drive Park
properties.Notes: Next to the Red River part of the Greenway Project and flood control it is now a park with cross country ski trails and a sledding area.

properties.Name: Remote Lake Solitude Area
properties.Notes: Hardwood forest and conifer stands along rolling hills with 13 km of wilderness touring with vista overlooks and 100-foot elevation changes. Log shelters. Located northeast of McGregor in the Savanna State Forest adjacent to Savanna Portage State Park.

properties.Name: Governor Thompson State Park
properties.Notes: A double loop system with two entry/exit points containing a one mile and 2 mile loop sections. Terrain has moderate hill on entry and exits and rolling and flat sections in the loops. Wide stake lanes with trail sections up to 25 ft in width.

properties.Name: Brunet Island State Park
properties.Notes: Brunet Island's trails pass through an otherwise undeveloped section of the park. The terrain is rolling with plenty of hills but none very large. Skiers pass through a mix of hardwood and evergreen forest and ski a ridge within sight of the Fisher River.

properties.Name: Carleton College Arboretum
properties.Notes: The Carleton College Arboretum trails are open to the public for skiing. The Upper Arb (6.3 km) is groomed for skating and classic and the Lower Arb (12.3 km) is groomed for classic only.

properties.Name: Root River State Trail
properties.Notes: The popular biking trail is groomed for classic skiing in the winter. Flat to gently rolling terrain most of it along the scenic Root River.

properties.Name: Essex Park Ski Trails
properties.Notes: A mix of newly constructed trails and existing bike paths located at Essex Park in NW Rochester. The northern trails are mostly wooded with many nice hills while the southern trails run through newly planted prairie. Groomed for both skate and classic by volunteers of the Rochester Active Sport Club.

properties.Name: Marshfield School Forest
properties.Notes: A heavily wooded trail system with a variety of trail loops for all ability levels. Several advanced trails have climbs of more that 60 vertical feet. The trail is maintained by the Marshfield Area Ski Touring Foundation. A lodge with a large fireplace and restrooms is open to skiers on weekends.

properties.Name: Kraemer Lake-Wildwood County Park
properties.Notes: The four miles of trails loop through hardwood forest and around wetlands. There are trails for every ability. Truly a beautiful site to see!

properties.Name: Sakatah Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Sakatah Lake State Park offers roughly 5 miles of groomed ski trails over rolling terrain. Located on the shore of Upper Sakatah Lake trails range from easy to difficult with most trails falling in the intermediate range.

properties.Name: Spring Rapids Trail
properties.Notes: Located in the Peshtigo River State Forest the Spring Rapids Trail System is 5 miles west of Crivitz on County Road W to Kirby Lake Lane. Features some steep hills and breathtaking views along the Peshtigo River.

properties.Name: Escanaba Trail
properties.Notes: This trail is very hilly rolling and scenic. It winds around five different lakes through stands of maple aspen and balsam. There are a couple fairly steep hills requiring intermediate skiing skills. A shelter with a fire ring is located on the trail.

properties.Name: McNaughton Lake Trail
properties.Notes: Mcnaughton Lake Trail follows old logging roads around three lakes and has very few steep hills. It is very scenic and an excellent trail for a beginner. A five and a half mile loop is groomed for skating. There is a shelter with a fire ring on the trail.

properties.Name: Iverson Park
properties.Notes: Short loop right in Stevens Point.

properties.Name: Irondale Trails
properties.Notes: Trails flow on hilly terrain along Rice Creek on Ramsey County open space land. Maintained by Irondale high school ski team and volunteers. Access from Irondale athletic fields or Poppyseed Drive.

properties.Name: Goose Lake Trail
properties.Notes: Easy to moderate classical groomed trail through hardwoods and mixed pine stands in the Chippewa National Forest. Only the parking lot off County 5 NE is open in the winter.

properties.Name: Newport State Park
properties.Notes: Rolling trails through evergreen and hardwood forests wetlands and upland meadows along Lake Michigan. 26.3 miles of trails are available for cross-country skiing including 12.5 miles groomed and tracked for classical skiing and 2 miles groomed for skate skiing

properties.Name: Wabana Trails
properties.Notes: Rated beginner/intermediate.

properties.Name: Camp Miller Loop
properties.Notes: The 9 miles of groomed ski trails spread over 340 acres at the YMCA Camp Miller. Wooded lakeshore some small vistas. Few people skijouring welcomed. Check in with Director upon arrival.

properties.Name: Bear Paw Trails
properties.Notes: This trail system is maintained by Bear Paw Outdoor Adventures. There is no fee and located on Bear Paw property and on private property. It is a mix of beginner trails and more advanced with a couple of steep climbs and downhills. Open and forested lands with a beautiful picnic point on the Wolf River.

properties.Name: Minneopa State Park
properties.Notes: The trail runs through oak savanna vegetation overlooking the Minnesota River and native prairie. A variety of wildlife can be seen.

properties.Name: Hayes Lake State Park
properties.Notes: Scenic views are numerous. The land is generally flat except ridges and river valleys formed by glacial activity.

properties.Name: Lac Lawrann Conservancy
properties.Notes: Within the West Bend city limits sits a 148-acre natural area connected another 35 acres of neighborhood park. It offers a beautiful setting in the hilly Kettle Moraine. The groomed trails traverse a prairie and take you through a deciduous woodland and a red pine plantation. Other ungroomed trails are open for both skiers and snow-shoers.

properties.Name: Prairie Woods Environmental Learning Center
properties.Notes: Varied terrain featuring prairie woods wetlands and scenic views from atop glacial ridges. Nice area for novice and intermediate skiers.

properties.Name: Cowhorn Lake
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate. Part of the Golden Anniversary State Forest.

properties.Name: Bridgewood Resort
properties.Notes: Rolling hills on the Bridgewood golf course groomed for skate skiing primarily.

properties.Name: Reid Golf Course
properties.Notes: Mainly flat with a few rollers. For 2012-2013 season there is constuction of two detention ponds on the course so the length will be reduced to one mile (stay out of the construction zone).

properties.Name: River Bend Nature Center
properties.Notes: Scenic trails along the woods prairie and Straight River. Located just east of the Faribault State Prison.

properties.Name: Perrot State Park
properties.Notes: Perrot State Park has cross country skiing and snowshoe trails in the La Crosse WI area. Primarily classic trails with just 1.5K skate section near the campground.

properties.Name: Ski Brule
properties.Notes: The wooded and rolling terrain of the Brule River Valley make Ski Brule's trail system a favorite amongst silent sport enthusiasts. Tracked and flat groomed trails are ideal for traditional cross country diagonal stride skiing ski skating and snowshoeing. The trail system winds along the base of the mountain and the Brule River offering scenic views to enjoy.

properties.Name: Iron River Cross Country Ski Center
properties.Notes: The Iron River Cross Country Ski Center offers six kilometers of groomed trails prepared for both classical and skating techniques at the George Young Recreational Complex. The varying terrain provides excellent skiing for all ability levels. Indoor amenities such as swimming pool spa locker rooms and sauna.

properties.Name: Hayward Recreational Forest
properties.Notes: Located just SW of Hayward features rolling to hilly terrain.

properties.Name: Hobson Forest Trail
properties.Notes: Trail runs through red and white pine and tamarack bog and beside Lake Lyra.

properties.Name: Cannon Valley Trail
properties.Notes: Trail stretches from Cannon Falls to Red Wing on an old railroad bed. Pretty much flat but quite scenic.

properties.Name: Snowflake Ski Club
properties.Notes: Primarily groomed for the Snowflake Nordic youth ski club. Site also has a full size ski jump.

properties.Name: Gateway State Trail
properties.Notes: Intermittently groomed double track usually from Jamaca Ave up to Pine Point Park.

properties.Name: Brooktree Golf Course
properties.Notes: Mostly flat but one gentle uphill/downhill in the southwest corner. Good easy skiing for families working on technique or a fast paced workout. Maintained by Owatonna Parks dept.

properties.Name: Kimberly High School Trails
properties.Notes: Roughly a quarter of the trails roll through the woods with two decent climbs. Use the back parking lot for skiing at the high school or during school hours please park in the church parking lot.

properties.Name: Combined Locks Trail
properties.Notes: Beautiful area but lots of walkers. Located at Memorial Park use the parking area located at the bottom of the sledding hill just south of Wallace Street on Park Street.

properties.Name: Squaw Creek County Park
properties.Notes: Mostly flat or gently rolling as it follows Squaw Creek. Trailhead is across the road from Red Cedar Lodge at the base of the sledding hill.

properties.Name: Quadna Mountain
properties.Notes: Rated beginner/intermediate.

properties.Name: Maple Bluff Country Club
properties.Notes: Gently rolling trails on the golf course.

properties.Name: Lac Qui Parle State Park
properties.Notes: The trail runs through flat flood plains along the shores of Lac qui Parle lake and the banks of the Lac qui Parle river.

properties.Name: Red Barn Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Groomed trails weave throughout 200 acres. Hills are moderate providing a perfect place for family skiing or those serious skiers looking for a nice afternoon in the woods.

properties.Name: Burl Oaks Golf Club
properties.Notes: The golf course trail wanders through thick strands of woods around ponds and over gentle hills. Restaurant and bar with an outdoor fire pit near the front side trail to stay warm and enjoy a hot chocolate.

properties.Name: Brandt Pines Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Part of the Governor Knowles State Forest Brandt Pines is an old-growth stand of large red and white pine along the St. Croix River. Throughout much of the trail you will either be on the top overlooking the ravine or right down in it.

properties.Name: No Achen Trail
properties.Notes: No Achen Bicentennial ski trail winds through wooded areas and around small lakes. Varying degrees of difficulty from easy to difficult. Known locally as the Tank Trail. Crosses private land please stay on the trail.

properties.Name: Viking Ship/Davy Park Trail
properties.Notes: Lighted trail along the Red River. Adjacent to the Hjemkomst Center. Park in the lower (west end) of the Hjemkomst lot and walk 50 feet north to get to the trail.

properties.Name: Ritter Farm Park
properties.Notes: Trail in woods and prairie. Multi-use trail (i.e. walkers) Groomed by local snowmobile club roughly twice a week.

properties.Name: Wyalusing State Park
properties.Notes: Trail access from Astronomy Center Parking lot and the Homestead Picnic Shelter parking lot.

properties.Name: Sugar Hills
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate/expert. Trails wind through hardwood forest with abundant wildlife. Thunder Peak provides an overview of up to 30 miles.

properties.Name: High Cliff State Park
properties.Notes: Trails are groomed and double-tracked for classical skiing. North Loop of the Horse/Bike Trail groomed for skate and classical skiing.

properties.Name: Jackson Meadow
properties.Notes: Rolling trails along the St. Croix River bluff located at Jackson Meadows. Most of the trail system is south of the housing area although some trails are set at the Central Meadow. 25% of trails are singletrack classic-only (narrow 6 ft wide trails).

properties.Name: My Lake Home Trails
properties.Notes: The My Lake Home B&B grooms single track trails within the Chippewa National Forest. The trails travel thru hardwood forest of red and white pines winding around frozen wetlands of cedars where viewing the lake is magnificent. There are a few easy and short side hills where Aspen and Birch preside. The varied terrain makes skiing enjoyable for the beginner intermediate and experienced skier.

properties.Name: Rice Lake Nordic Association
properties.Notes: Two loops groomed for both skate & classic. Basically a flat trail great for beginners. Good night skiing with lighting from the nearby streets.

properties.Name: Pinicon Ridge Park
properties.Notes: This 925-acre park along the Wapsipinicon River has long been admired for its scenic natural beauty. The hilly heavily wooded area is divided by the river and home to many species of wildlife.

properties.Name: Matsell Bridge Natural Area
properties.Notes: Matsell Bridge Natural Area features an extensive cross country ski trail system. The system includes skate and traditional cross country skiing trails.

properties.Name: Halls Creek Trail
properties.Notes: The trail consists of varied landscapes with frequent short hill climbs and descents. It accommodates beginner to intermediate skiing skills.

properties.Name: Lanesboro Golf Course
properties.Notes: Groomed for skating and classic by the Root River Nordic Ski Club. Easy and challenging loops on the bluff overlooking Lanesboro and the surrounding river valley. Access points at the golf clubhouse or adjacent to the Lanesboro Cemetery.

properties.Name: Hornet Hiihto Trails
properties.Notes: Located in Creek Valley Park the trails run behind Creek Valley Elementary and Edina High School. There is a 1/2K snowmaking loop.

properties.Name: He-Nis-Ra Park
properties.Notes: A natural wooded park within the city limits of Green Bay. The terrain is moderately hilly with hardwood forested hills and a wetlands area in the middle of the park.

properties.Name: Menomonee Park
properties.Notes: Nice groomed skiing track that loops around this small Waukesha County Park (also known locally as Lannon Quarry). Can be reached via the bugline recreation trail.

properties.Name: Hartman Creek State Park
properties.Notes: Scenic trail system with a number of hills.

properties.Name: Scotch Creek Woodland Preserve
properties.Notes: The entire system is typically groomed with one set of tracks that wind through beginner to intermediate forested and prairie terrain. The football field and baseball field loops are double tracked flanking the freestyle lane. Wooded portions with a single set of classic tracks have ~5 to 6 feet of groomed width for snowshoers or freestyle skiing.

properties.Name: Land O' Lakes Trail
properties.Notes: The East Trails travel through a forest dominated by evergreens with terrain that is gentle and rolling and suitable for skiers of all abilities. The West Trails travel through a forest of primarily hardwoods and offer more hills and winding runs through the natural hilly terrain.

properties.Name: Saint John's Abbey Arboretum
properties.Notes: Almost 20 kilometers of skating and classic trails over mostly hilly terrain. Located adjacent to Saint John's Abbey University and Preparatory School.

properties.Name: Voyager Village Golf Course
properties.Notes: A mix of gently rolling and flat at terrain on the front nine a slightly more challenging grade on the back 9. Hanscom classic only trail set in the deep woods.

properties.Name: Kickapoo Valley Reserve
properties.Notes: The five miles of the Old Highway 131 Trail provide an excellent opportunity to experience the solitude and beauty of the Reserve. Other groomed trails include the Dam Trail Old Harris Road Trail and Star Valley Road.

properties.Name: Stower Seven Lakes State Trail
properties.Notes: Built on a former railroad corridor this 14-mile trail begins in Amery travels through the communities of Deronda Wanderoos and Nye ending near Dresser.

properties.Name: Northwoods Christian Camp Ski Trails
properties.Notes: There are a few small hills but mostly rolling flats. The trails are primarily in the woods with one loop that is more exposed. There is a lodge with bathrooms and area to change clothes.

properties.Name: Ge-Che Trail
properties.Notes: Classical ski track groomed double wide for much of the trail with some flat stretches and hills of varying difficulty in primarily hardwood forests with views of Hagerman Ottawa and Bennan Lakes. The trail is maintained and groomed by Covenant Point Bible Camp.

properties.Name: Bay Beach Wildlife Sanctuary
properties.Notes: The Bay Beach Wildlife Sanctuary is an urban wildlife refuge where people and animals can come together for mutual benefits.

properties.Name: Simpson Creek
properties.Notes: Rated beginner/intermediate trails run along the north shore of Lake Winnibigoshish in the Chippewa National Forest.

properties.Name: Green Haven Golf Course
properties.Notes: Rolling terrain groomed 3 to 5 days per week. Very pretty! Park in the course parking lot and trailhead near the first tee.

properties.Name: Anoka Nature Preserve
properties.Notes: Trails run through the Anoka Nature Preserve. Groomed 3 to 5 days per week. Very nice rolling terrain.

properties.Name: River Road Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Located in Harold Walters Memorial Forest the trail winds through undulating terrain with great scenery including big hardwoods and conifers beaver ponds wetlands and the Chippewa River. Well-behaved dogs are welcome on this trail.

properties.Name: Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore
properties.Notes: Trails flow along the Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore and range from easy to intermediate. Groomed classic only.

properties.Name: University Ridge Golf Course
properties.Notes: The course sits on the terminal moraine where the Wisconsin Glacier stopped forming the backbone of the ridge that separates the land into groups of rolling hills and valleys.

properties.Name: Braemar Golf Course
properties.Notes: Braemar Park offers two trails that are groomed over the golf course.

properties.Name: Douglas County Ski Trails
properties.Notes: Easy flowing trails through the Douglas County Forest.

properties.Name: Whitetail Woods Regional Park
properties.Notes: Scenic park with trails bordering a lake hills and wetlands. Ski trails primarily rolling. Adjacent to UMore Park. Some segments of the trail are shared use with hikers.

properties.Name: Scenic State Park
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate. Trail runs along a glacial ridge and through virgin pine forest.

properties.Name: Hayward Hospital Trails
properties.Notes: Located close to town behind the Hayward Area Memorial Hospital the 7.5 miles of trails are a mix of flat and easy rolling terrain winding around a lake and through pines and hardwoods.

properties.Name: Pilot Knob State Park
properties.Notes: Some ski trails are multi-use. Warming house with electricity and heat.

properties.Name: Trego Lake Trails
properties.Notes: Small but quiet trail along the shoreline of Trego lake on the Namekagon river.

properties.Name: Sauk Centre Public School Trail
properties.Notes: Trails are located between the athletic fields and the Sauk River on the east side of town. The trails are rated easy to moderate with cut-offs to avoid the few large hills.

properties.Name: Miners Memorial Heritage Park
properties.Notes: Fairly easy trail right in Ironwood used for part of the SISU Ski Fest races in January.

properties.Name: Trade River Trail
properties.Notes: Easy rolling trails. Ice Age National trail passes through part of this trail system.

properties.Name: Thistledew
properties.Notes: Rated intermediate/expert.

properties.Name: Burlington School Forest
properties.Notes: There is 3.5k of ski trail on gentle rolling terrain through a forest canopy. The trails are groomed by the Burlington High School ski club.

properties.Name: Carey Lake
properties.Notes: Trail in the woods also goes around lake. 10k of the trail has side by side classic and skate the other 10k is classic only. Views of the lake lowlands bogs and jack pine stands. Black Forest loop (3.8K) is lit.

properties.Name: Savanna Portage State Park
properties.Notes: Trails are next door to the Remote Solitude Area.

properties.Name: Stoney Ridge
properties.Notes: Trails run gently through birch and maple hardwoods wildlife frequently seen. Located north of Nashwauk on Hwy 65.

properties.Name: Prairie Springs
properties.Notes: Gentle terrain mix of forest and open field. Trailhead is at the Howard County Conservation lot in Vernon Springs.

properties.Name: Lake Emily Trail
properties.Notes: Rolling terrain medium difficulty experience. North and south loops.

properties.Name: Pioneer Creek Trails
properties.Notes: Pioneer Creek Trails run through the scenic Vilas County Forest. Trail location is in the Conover Town Park 1/4 mile east of U.S. 45 on the south side of County Hwy K. Amenities include a heated restroom.

properties.Name: Kohler-Andrae State Park
properties.Notes: The two-mile ski trail has flat to gentle slopes and takes you through a variety of beautiful environments. The trail starts in the picnic area and travels through the wooded southern campground. It then hooks up to the Woodland Dunes Nature Trail and later loops through the picnic area back to the beginning. Trail system is one-way.

properties.Name: Door Creek Park
properties.Notes: Classic only trails in the woods.

properties.Name: Yahara Hills Golf Course
properties.Notes: Rolling trails around and through the golf course. Shelter concessions and rentals on weekends.

properties.Name: Grand Avenue Nordic Center
properties.Notes: Nordic-dedicated snowmaking daily grooming and a full-service chalet located at the bottom of Spirit Mountain. Currently 2.5K of snowmaking. Expansion plans call for connector trail linking the new trail to the 22 km of existing trail at the top of Spirit Mountain.

properties.Name: Long Lake Conservation Center
properties.Notes: Long Lake Conservation Center is a Aitkin County Park located 6 miles south of Palisade. The classic only trails offer beautiful views from heavy timber and black spruce bogs to overlooks of Long lake.

properties.Name: Vispo County Park
properties.Notes: Vispo is a Aitkin County Park located 13 miles South East of Aitkin. Vispo is an old farmstead that is is now managed for open spaces as well as timber and recreation. Vispo trails offer a combination of open rolling hills as well as small lakes and wooded areas.

properties.Name: Erbach Park
properties.Notes: Erbach Park has over 200 acres of hardwood forest nestled along the Black Creek in Athens WI. Seven miles of groomed trails in the winter. Trails are accessible to XC classic and skate technique as well as snowshoeing and walking.

properties.Name: Norpine (Deeryard/Lutsen)
properties.Notes: Trails for beginner to advanced offering views of Lake Superior Cascade River and Deer Yard Lake. Ski through birch pine and aspen with 28km of double tracked trails and 30km of skate/classic trails. Groomed with a Pisten Bully machine. A State Ski Pass is required to ski on our trails and is available at the office.

properties.Name: McCarthy Beach State Park
properties.Notes: Scenic trails wind through stands of large red and white pines. For longer ventures head out on the Taconite Trail for access to hundreds of miles of additional trails.

properties.Name: Terrace Oaks Park
properties.Notes: A great hilly trail system completely in the woods. Because of the woods the trails hold their snow better than most.

properties.Name: Sunfish Lake Park
properties.Notes: Most trails ramble through hardwood forest along any of several routes across all difficulty levels. Camel Back provides some fun hills but Oak Run is particularly exciting. Morgan Lane offers beautiful view of a pond from a birch-lined ridge while effortlessly gliding back to the trailhead. Deer and winter songbirds frequently seen.

properties.Name: Theodore Wirth North
properties.Notes: North Wirth Park includes 13 kilometers of groomed trail. The North Wirth trails include a mix of beginner intermediate and advanced trails. Trails include Hap Lutter Loop (lighted 3.3K snowmaking) Skyline Trail Back-40/Twin Lake Trail Judy Lutter Trail and Tornado Alley Trail.

properties.Name: Cross Country Ski Shop
properties.Notes: 5.5 K groomed skating & classic. Pretty flat, but some of the trails are groomed 30' wide!

properties.Name: Enchanted Forest
properties.Notes: Note that grooming may be sporadic. Beautiful area, though.

properties.Name: Grand Mesa
properties.Notes: Located on top of the flat-top of the Grand Mesa outside of Grand Junction, Colorado. 11,000 feet altitude makes for great, challenging skiing.

properties.Name: MacDonald Pass Cross Country Ski Trails
Hillside Ski Area
properties.Notes: Well maintained trails used as the start of the 40k and 50k races in the Tour of Anchorage.

properties.Name: Overland Ski Club
properties.Notes:
Located just 25 km south of Kamloops, our family-friendly destination is a winter playground for anyone who loves sunshine and great snow!
 
 At Stake Lake you’ll find a variety of options to suit every skill and interest level:
 60 km of scenic, expertly groomed cross country ski trails
 5 km of dedicated dog-friendly trails
 12 km of snowshoe trails
 
 Take in the fresh air while exploring this truly fabulous network of trails. Skiers of all ages and levels will enjoy our trails and family-friendly atmosphere!

properties.Name: Raven Golf Club
properties.Notes: Golf course, groomed for classic and skate. No rentals on site. No trail pass required.

properties.Name: Whitehorse area
properties.Notes: The greater Whitehorse area offers everything from world class groomed trails to biathlon courses and off track woodland trails. With an extended skiing season over the majority of North America it is one of the hidden gems of the cross country ski world.

properties.Name: Charlevoix X/C Ski Trail
properties.Notes: Jan 1, 2001: 2K loop, lighted. It appeared to be about 4 feet wide and simply groomed by a snowmobile running over it.

properties.Name: Echo Lake Trails
properties.Notes: 14 km groomed trail, 15 km ungroomed. Adjacent to Discovery Ski Area

properties.Name: Leelanau Trail
properties.Notes: The Leelanau Trail is 15.4 miles long and over 80% of it is non-paved, so ideal for skiing in the winter. Also, some of it is paved for summer skiers. The trail was once a Michigan Scenic Railroad and takes users through beautiful rural countryside.

properties.Name: Leslie Park Golf Course, (Ann Arbor Municipal)
properties.Notes: Where I learned to XC ski. Hilly but ungroomed.

properties.Name: Moulton Ski Trails
properties.Notes: At the end of Moulton Reservoir Rd, 10 miles North of Butte

properties.Name: Pando
properties.Notes: 10 miles of groomed trails

properties.Name: Radrick Farms Golf Course (University of Michigan)
properties.Notes: Not groomed, but it might be the only place with snow.

properties.Name: Skalkaho Pass Road
properties.Notes: mixed used road

properties.Name: Traverse City
properties.Notes: The Vasa Pathway is located in Acme Township and is a 28 mile system of trails in the Pere Marquette State Forest. In the winter, the trail is groomed for both skating and classic skiing by TART Trails volunteers. The Vasa Race takes place on trail every February. There is free parking and bathroom facilities at the trailhead which is off Bartlett Road.

properties.Name: Wildwood Hills Pathway
properties.Notes: 15K, 3 Loops, groomed for skating & striding

properties.Name: White Pass Nordic Center
properties.Notes: Excellent grooming, classic and skate, snowshoeing.
